articleTitle: On the application of metamaterials for output power increasing of multibeam Klystrons
abstract: A metamaterial in the array form of inductive posts is proposed for realization of overmoded cavities making possible to increase the number of beams and output power of the klystron.

articleTitle: Minimum-phase methods' reference set construction based on a statistical resolution limit
abstract: The research considers minimum-phase methods' reference set construction process, which utilizes the framework of the statistical resolution limit (SRL) criterion. SRL lower bound (by means of Cramer-Rao lower bound) and its dependence on the input signal-to-noise ratio and a sample size is obtained and analyzed.

articleTitle: Research of the channel of the range coherent radar with the onboard superregenerative respondent
abstract: The problems of formation and reception of a reciprocal signal of the superregenerative transceiver of an aerological radiosonde in the channel of measurement of the inclined range of the aerological coherent radar are discussed.

articleTitle: Influence of sink-source channel's width on Ft and Fmax limit frequencies of AlGaN/GaN HEMT
abstract: It is shown that increasing of full width W of the sink-source channel in Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">70</inf>N/GaN HEMT at the expense of the increase of n (a number of sections) results to decreasing of G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf>(F) and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf>(F). Therefore, amplifying limit frequencies of current F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> and power F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> also decrease. F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">t</inf> and F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> decrease at the increasing of n is related with increasing parasitic parameters of Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</inf>Ga<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">70</inf>N/GaN HEMT.

articleTitle: GaAs MMIC digital phase shifter and attenuator for space-based APAR
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of design and manufacturing of digital phase shifter and attenuator for space-based active phased array radar. The MMIC are realized in the 0.18um pHEMT (ED02AH) process of OMMIC foundry.

articleTitle: Department of Electronics, Oscillations and Waves of Saratov State University celebrates the 60th anniversary
abstract: The brief history of the Department of Electronics, Oscillations and Waves of Saratov State University is presented. This year, the Department of Electronics, Oscillations and Waves celebrates the 60<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> anniversary. Department of Electronics Oscillations and Waves is one of the leading departments of Saratov State University training specialists for the electronic industry.

articleTitle: The history of radio recounted on the pages of nautical collected works (1919–1929)
abstract: Hostility experience in WWI period had shown radio communication possibilities in the modern war, caused rapid development of radio engineering in the 20's of XX century. The present paper gives a short review of articles concerning history of radio engineering from "Morskoy Sbornik" (Marine Collection) magazine from 1919 to 1929.

articleTitle: Vladimir Mikhaylovich Rodionov — The founder of the domestic historiography methodology in the field of radio technologies (to his 90th anniversary)
abstract: Using a method of bibliographic reconstruction of the biography the analysis of activities of Vladimir Mikhaylovich Rodionov (1922–1988), the founder of the domestic historiography methodology in the field of radio technologies, is carried out.

articleTitle: Relay approaches in the LTE Advanced network
abstract: Relaying is one of the proposed technologies for 3GPP LTE-Advanced networks, one of the main tasks of which is an increase of network capacity and the expansion of its coverage area. A method of dynamic relay in LTE Advanced networks was introduced. That method still maintains compatibility with the user's equipment LTE Release 8, and does not limit the flexibility and reliability expected from the relay.

articleTitle: Gunn diode as a noise generator
abstract: It is shown that in case with uniformly doped GD base there is no way of developing high-field domain. Instead of this negative-charged accumulation layer appears and moves from cathode to anode. Simultaneously appears an excess of electrons in anode region of the high-field. Spontaneous excitation and relaxation of electrons in this region probably leads to white noise generation within quite wide frequency band. It is shown that arising of classical high-field domain requires nonuniformly doped base of GD.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic simulation of insertion losses in planar microwave device
abstract: The ways of model insertion losses in conductors and substrates of planar microwave structures in electromagnetic simulation program based on the vector finite element method are studied. Analysis of the data showed that for improving the accuracy of losses simulation it is necessary to simulate a planar line as a three-dimensional object from a dielectric medium with high conductivity.

articleTitle: To 80th anniversary of Professor Lyubov Mikhaylovna Lobkova
abstract: A brief biography of Professor Lyubov Mikhaylovna Lobkova is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: Control operations perfection of magnetrons manufacturing technological process
abstract: Real magnetron resonator systems metrological expedients of the conformity observational estimate to the spatial harmonics spectrum "fracture" tolerance limits of a slowing down system high-frequency field are featured.

articleTitle: Passive MIC for power aplifier based on discrete GaN-transistors
abstract: Presented in this paper are the results of creation of summing/correction/matching circuits for microwave power amplifiers, performed as GaAs-based monolithic ICs.

articleTitle: To 70th anniversary of Professor Alexei Philippovich Yanenko
abstract: A brief biography of Professor Alexei Philippovich Yanenko is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: Design feature of superwideband terminations and attenuators on CVD diamond wafer
abstract: The present article concerns a design feature of super wideband terminations and attenuators on CVD diamond wafer.

articleTitle: To 60th anniversary of Professor Yevgeniy Yevgenievich Nechaev
abstract: A brief biography of Professor Yevgeniy Yevgenievich Nechaev is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: About prospects of creation the short-wave part of the millimeter range coaxial magnetron
abstract: The possibility of creating a 4-mm wavelengths coaxial magnetron is considered. The current status in the development and application of the short-wave part of the millimeter-wave band analyzed. A series of recommendations are made to get around the difficulties caused by the diminishing wavelength of a signal being generated. An algorithm for designing millimeter wave coaxial magnetron is developed.

articleTitle: High power monolithic pin-diode T/R-switch/limiter
abstract: This paper presents results of development of X-band high power monolithic pin-diode T/R-switch/limiter.

articleTitle: To 60th anniversary of Kees van't Klooster
abstract: A brief biography of Kees van't Klooster is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: Simulation of operation of Gunn diodes with short active layer
abstract: Gunn diode operation based on two-temperature model was investigated in (10…50) GHz frequency band. It is shown that with a (1.0…1.8) μm active layer's length and with the positive linear gradient of electron density distribution in the diode's base, Gunn diodes can operate with efficiency of 6% at the first harmonic.

articleTitle: Analysis of filter parameters on quarter-wave hairpin resonators
abstract: The experimental study results and PC analysis of microstrip hairpin filters on quarter-wave resonators are presented. Some recommendations to get optimum performance are given.

articleTitle: Electric frequency tuning calculation of resonator with avalanche diode in system «pin with a gap — Short with hollow»
abstract: The relation (1) for description of electric frequency tuning of resonator with avalanche diode in the system «pin with a gap — short with hollow» depending on change of diode voltage is obtained. In order to perform calculations using this relation, it is necessary to keep two experimental values of resonant frequency at two different values of voltage.

articleTitle: Specific features of autodyne response formation in case of the "fast" reflector motion
abstract: The analysis results of specific features of forming microwave oscillators' dynamic characteristics under the influence of emission reflected from the "fast" moving objects are presented. We derived expressions and plotted graphs of phase, frequency, amplitude characteristics and autodetection characteristics of the microwave oscillator for cases of approaching and moving away objects. The particulars of their behavior depending on the autodyne signal frequency and the direction of object motion are introduced on the basis of the results of numerical calculations of the characteristics.

articleTitle: Cathode switch — The first amplifier tube
abstract: Presented in this paper is detailed study of the invention of the first amplifying vacuum tubes. It is shown that Robert von Lieben has designed the original vacuum tube amplifier only to increase the low-frequency electrical oscillations (telephone translation), while the three-electrode vacuum tube created by Lee de Forest was created specifically to enhance the radio antenna received radio. It is noted that these inventions have different prototypes: cathode-ray tube — for von Lieben, and oscillation valve — for de Forest. Comparing the dates of the received patents two scientists, it is obvious that priority in the invention of vacuum electronic lamp for electric signal amplification, belongs to Robert von Lieben, and radio frequency amplification belongs to Lee de Forest.

articleTitle: Edison's effect — The invention that surpassed scientific and technical progress
abstract: It is shown that two-electrode vacuum electron tube invented by T. Edison (1883) surpassed scientific and technical progress of that time. There was no scientific and technical area where this radio component could be applied. However, T. Edison's vacuum diode had completed design, and it could be used in radio receivers as detecting element of radio signal. It was confirmed by further experiments (1933).

articleTitle: Estimation scheme for improvement of weighted round robin algorithm for requests service in the queues
abstract: The article reviews the main approaches to optimization of commutation center functioning. The weighted round robin (WRR) algorithm is approved. It allows processing an unforeseen peak of the load efficiently. Such unforeseen peaks of the load are typical for the self-similar traffic at the expense of load dynamic size changing which can be directed from the high priority queue to the low priority queue.

articleTitle: Features of weakly gyrotropic ferrite resonators excitation in millimeter band
abstract: Nonreciprocal excitation of dielectric resonances has been investigated for LM<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">mδn</inf> mode in a weakly gyrotropic ferrite resonator for the millimeter band. The waveguide cell shows nonreciprocal transmission of 10 dB and the frequency-tuning rate of 130 MHz / kOe. The possibility of numerical modeling of microwave components with weakly gyrotropic ferrite resonators has been shown in CAD Microwave Studio.

articleTitle: Research of sensitivity increase methods for the transistor superregenerative transceivers
abstract: The methods of decreasing of shock oscillations of starting current in the receiving mode of the superregenerative transceiver of a radiosonde are considered.

articleTitle: Trends of creation of the telecommunication systems for multiservice access with using MITRIS radio technology
abstract: The results of development of the wireless microwave systems using radio-technology MITRIS are presented. Analysis of the system MITRIS development allows determining the prospective trends on the modern stage of multiservice radio-access systems creation for broadcast-information complexes, in which there is possibility for compatible interaction of three main networks: the digital television broadcast, the interactive data transfer with access to extranets of IP format, the video-information gathering (video surveillance). The microwave integrated system of multiservice access designed in frequency bands (11.7…12.5) GHz; (10.15…10.30) GHz and (10.50…10.65) GHz was described. The advanced trends of study were examined.

articleTitle: 2-mm Wavelength orotron with DRPS and broad electron beam
abstract: The possibility of output power increase is experimentally demonstrated in 2-mm orotron by means of the focusing mirror of two-focus sphere-cylindrical open resonator to increase an electron flow width up to 4 caustic radii, and from the element of cylinder both transversely and along the flow. The 20…30% tuning frequency range with 5 dB nonuniformity of output power is also shown.

articleTitle: Yevgeniy Viktorovich Kolbasyev — A naval officer, an originator and a pioner of implementation of telephone communication on the ships of the Russian Navy (to the 150th anniversary)
abstract: Activities of a naval officer, an initiator and a pioneer of implementation of telephone communication onboard the ships of the Russian Navy, Yegeniy Viktorovich Kolbasyev (1862–1920), are considered. Two periods of activities of Ye. V. Kolbasyev are separated for Kronstadt and Sevastopol.

articleTitle: X-range wave length amplifier with output pulse power no less than 25 W
abstract: The five-stage amplifier of the X-range of wave lengths, providing output pulse power no less than 25 W in a five-percentage frequency band with gain amount of 28–30 dB, is developed. All VHF components and sites are made by "Istok" Federal State Unitary Enterprise.

articleTitle: Calculation tasks of “strength of materials” portal model
abstract: The report presents the approach to the calculation tasks for knowledge portal models designing (using the portal in the fields of strength of materials). The meta-model of calculation tasks is described.

articleTitle: Coborg technology for creation of intellectual systems of diagnosing and controlling of objects with complicated structure
abstract: In this paper we characterize the fields of coborg technology application to the problem of diagnosing and conrolling of complicated objects. Peculiarities of multiagent coborg technology operation are considered. It is noted that coborg determining attributes are internal status parameters, which are divided into individual and complex parameters. Basic advantages of coborg technology are decreasing of intellectual circuits design time as well as labor inputs of their maintenance.

articleTitle: A 80th birthday tribute to Professor Yevgeny Nefyodov
abstract: Summary form only given, as follows. Yevgeny Ivanovich Nefyodov was born on August 19, 1932, in Taganrog. In 1956 he graduated from the Higher Engineering Academy for Communications (Leningrad), and in 1964 completed his post-graduate studies at the Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics of the USSR Academy of Sciences. In 1965 he successfully defended his PhD thesis and in 1976 - his doctoral thesis. In 1956-1957 Yevgeny Nefyodov served in the Soviet Armed Forces, following which he lectured at the Taganrog Radio Engineering Institute (1957-1961). Since 1962 he has been working at the Institute of Radio Engineering and Electronics of the Russian Academy of Sciences. Professor Nefyodov is a leading expert in the field of microwave electrodynamics. He has written more than 20 monographs, most of which were published by Nauka Publishing House between 1969 and 1990, and more than 200 research papers. Professor Nefyodov is a founder of a new scientific school: 3D microwave ICs. He has trained a whole galaxy of talented disciples. During the Soviet era Professor Nefyodov managed a large number of scientific and technical conferences and practical workshops in many areas of the USSR, including Zaporizhzhia, Sevastopol, Moscow, Suzdal, Tbilisi, Alma-Ata, Volgograd, Kaliningrad, Taganrog, Samara, etc. Professor Nefyodov was one of CriMiCo's founding fathers, sponsors and served on the Program Committee of CriMiCo between 1991 and 1994.

articleTitle: 2.0–6.0 GHz GaAs MMIC amplifier
abstract: The paper presents the results of designing microwave monolithic integrated circuit of two-stage amplifier produced on pHEMT substrate with chip size 2.4×1.6 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and providing 16.5 dB conversion gain and 15 dBm P1dB on 2.0–6.0 GHz. The method of MMIC multistage amplifier designing is developed. FET topology has been optimized for minimization of parasitic parameters and maximization of dynamic range. GaAs pHEMT MMIC two-stage amplifiers are developed and manufactured by using MESFET with 0.7 μm gate's length as an active element. Characteristics of the device are investigated experimentally in 2.0–6.0 GHz frequency range. Results of measurements are agreed with calculation data and confirm effectiveness of the developed method of designing.

articleTitle: On 60th anniversary of Associate Professor Igor Leonidovich Vetrov
abstract: A brief biography of Professor Igor Leonidovich Vetrov is given highlighting his professional achievements.

articleTitle: Real-space transfer and peculiarities of electric field domain localization in HEMT's
abstract: The results of physical mechanisms investigations responsible for hard electric field domain and heat generation sources localization near the drain's gate edge in HEMT's are presented. It is shown that the hard localization effect typical only for HEMT's, not typical for FET's, as a result of realspace transfer.

articleTitle: Research of GaN PHEMT LNA input power endurance
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental research of power endurance of LNA on GaN transistors are presented. The measured microwave parameters are given.

articleTitle: Enhancement of informative checking of the magnetron's oscillatory system parameters at a low power level
abstract: The “destruction” of spectrum of space HF-field harmonics in the slow-wave structure of the mm-wave magnetron is indirectly estimated. The estimation procedure allows the flaws that come about in the manufacture to be detected in due course. These flaws are normally found to result in emerging hidden defects in terms of efficiency values.

articleTitle: Ambiguity of quasistationary quantum states for double photon transition in triple-barrier structures
abstract: It is revealed that for the asymmetrical three-barrier resonant and tunnel structures with thin high barriers the system of non-stationary self-consistent Schrödinger and Poisson equations with open edge conditions on all channels of the dispersion, describing resonant transitions between three quantum levels in the strong high-frequency electrical field in case of the same edge conditions can have some decisions corresponding to different quantum statuses.

articleTitle: Nitride galium Gunn diode of millimeter range
abstract: Static and microwave characteristics of millimeter range GaN diode with 2-μm active layer length and doping level of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">17</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−3</sup> are investigated in two-temperature approaching. Frequency dependences of microwave efficiency are calculated at different bias voltage for the diode in a single resonant electric circuit. Maximal efficiency is of 1.5 % at frequencies near 100 GHz.

articleTitle: Negative resistance of rectifying metal-semiconductor junction
abstract: It was shown that in the region of direct current with U<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">f</inf>>qϕ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf> there is the negative resistance part at static VAC of rectifying metal-semiconductor junctions. Theoretical calculation reveals that negative resistance on the direct brunch of VAC is caused by potential step in order to transfer ballistic electrons through a thin base (∼0.1 um) of the diode. Analysis of transferring time τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf>(E) and reflecting time τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R</inf>(E) makes it possible to calculate estimating frequency band < 1 THz.

articleTitle: Influence of positron annealing on static and microwave characteristics of low-frequence AlGaN/GaN HEMT
abstract: Obtained results show, that used modes of positron annealing of low-frequency (1–3 GHz) HEMT lead to rising of power and current gains (G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> and H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</inf> respectively). The value of cutoff frequency Ft does not decrease, and the Fmax raised. According to S-parameters of low-frequency (1–3 GHz) HEMT at high-frequency (20–40 GHz) range, one can see parameters degradation of the used construction. To improve microwave HEMT in 20–40 GHz range, obviously, it is necessary to use high-frequency construction of heteroepitaxial structure and other modes of positron annealing.

articleTitle: Experimental research of autodyne and modulation characteristics of microwave oscillators
abstract: The results of experimental research of microwave oscillators' dynamic autodyne and modulation characteristics are presented. This research was held to verify the conclusions of the theoretical analysis of these characteristics by way of the example of a hybrid-integrated oscillator module "Tigel-08" based on an 8-mm range two-mesa Gunn diode.

articleTitle: Research of the reciprocal signal of the transceiver of the radiosonde on the radar request signal
abstract: The results of researches of an error of measurement by means of the pulse method of an inclined range to the aerological radar radiosonde are considered.

articleTitle: The phase detectors based on AD8302 for millimeter wave heterodyne interferometer
abstract: The paper presents the results of the development the phase detectors for 2-millimeter two-frequency interferometer. Proposed circuit solutions allow eliminating the ambiguity of phase measurements when using the AD8302 chip and measuring the fast phase changes within 0–360<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>, and relative phase measurements in the range N∗2π, (where N < 66). The phase detectors have been tested in the heterodyne interferometer in tokamak "COMPASS-D".

articleTitle: Ultra-short pulse meter of current-voltage and capacitance-voltage characteristics for Ni LabVIEW
abstract: The peculiarities of practical realization of the method, that provides measurement of the current-voltage and capacitance-voltage characteristics by ultra-short pulses, are considered.

articleTitle: A 30-GHz cross-like analyzer of complex reflection factor
abstract: The mathematical model of cross-like network analyzer using partially crossed zone method is developed. The dependency between measurements results and the number of higher-order modes in mathematical model is analysed. The wideband measurements error was calculated using the moving load.

articleTitle: InSb-based electron devices
abstract: As far beck as 1997 it was demonstrated [1.2] that the InSb compound is the highly promising material to be used for practical nanoelectronics. In 2005 the Intel company came forward with a special report wich it stated that a new quantum transistor with an InSb-based conductive channel had been engineered. The out come of the Intel technological advances in this field was regarded as the Moore's law prolongation that would be valid for more than ten years ahead. InSb is the best candidate as an substitude for Si in modern electronics and this material has by now been the material to be extensively studied in the USA and China.

articleTitle: Use of wireless nodes in grid system of personal computers
abstract: The article concerns the current issues of creating an environment for the placement and execution highly loaded web service - components of distributed information systems, which have a dynamically changing heterogeneous architecture.

articleTitle: Express simulation of nanoradio and resonant-tunneling carbon nanotubes based structures
abstract: An engineering method for simulating nanoradio and active elements based on resonant-tunneling structures (RTS) was proposed. Its possibilities for calculating the main characteristics of these devices were illustrated.

articleTitle: The symmetrical vibrators in magnetic crystals
abstract: On the basis of the exact solutions of Maxwell's equations for the magnetic crystal the directional diagrams of symmetrical vibrators in near and far zones are obtained.

articleTitle: Method of reducing the billing system load in critical mode
abstract: The billing system is the heart of the telecommunication services network operator. The customer satisfaction and profit of the operator depend on its proper operation. Therefore we developed a method of reducing the billing system load in a critical mode.

articleTitle: Formation of straight-through pores in silicon substrates for 3-D metal interconnections
abstract: Silicon substrates with ordered pores, which go through the whole sample, have been fabricated for 3-D metal interconnections. The inter-pore distance can be ranged from 4 to 10 μm. The thickness of silicon substrate can reach up to 200-300 μm. The ordered porous structures are obtained by a photolithographic process.

articleTitle: Investigation of characteristics of the disk liquid resonator with higher azimuthal modes
abstract: Spectral and field characteristics of the open disk liquid resonator in the four-millimeter waveband are experimentally investigated. The resonator is made as the thin-walled cuvette filled by a liquid in which whispering gallery modes are excited. The construction of the resonator is convenient for studying of characteristics of disk resonators in view of possibility of change of its parameters and sizes. Possibility of use of the resonator for studying of nonpolar liquids properties is shown.

articleTitle: Characteristics of shields composite coatings based on nanodisperse particles
abstract: The dependences of shielding effectiveness of electromagnetic field on the structure of inhomogeneous nano-composite material are studied.

articleTitle: Nonlinear EE_HEMT model of GaN transistor
abstract: The present paper concerns the results of creating a nonlinear EE_HEMT model of TGF2023-01 transistor. The results of large signal matching simulation, comparison modeling results and Triquint data are presented.

articleTitle: Echo-free cell-based antenna measuring and computing complex
abstract: Echo-free cell-based antenna measuring and computing complex (AMCC) is designed in the Moscow State Aviation Institute (National Research University) MAI, at the Aircraft Radio Electronics Department. The complex is assigned for automatized measuring of radio engineering characteristics of antennas, antenna systems and microwave devices.

articleTitle: Experimental determination of spaceborne SAR radiometric resolution
abstract: The method of test signal generation for space-borne SAR radiometric resolution experimental measurement is proposed. The distributed target echo signal is simulated by means of an active receiver in flight tests and by means of a hardware-in-the-loop workbench in ground tests. Radar test image analysis is performed using Differential Radiocontrast method.

articleTitle: Millimeter-wave scattering by prefractal diffraction gratings
abstract: The description of the test bench for investigation of processes of diffraction of electromagnetic waves by scattering structures and the results of experimental and theoretical research of characteristics of electromagnetic wave scattering by the prefractal diffraction gratings (PFDG) with variable Hausdorff dimension are presented. The study was fulfilled in the gigahertz frequency range (36-50 GHz). The comparison of experimental results with numerical calculations is carried out.

articleTitle: Diagnostics of electrical contacts quality by the nonlinear reflectometry adjusted for thermoeffects
abstract: Experimental investigation of checking possibility of diagnostics of electrical contacts using the nonlinear reflectometry method in terms of the thermo effects was carried out. The summary gives the characteristics of nonlinearity high-quality and defective electrical contacts, associated with their reaction to test.

articleTitle: Separation of objects on complex scenes based on radar monitoring data
abstract: Objects detection and separation approach based on spots grouping on a radar image into a single object is shown. There is considered an approach based on grouping of some “spots” acquired from a separate object with assumption of spatial relations of these spots.

articleTitle: Noise immunity in data channel of multifunction information systems
abstract: Methods of forming of spread spectrum signals are analyzed. Method and hardware realization of a subsystem to define a mean power value of noise which has high correlation properties with pseudonoise signals used for spread spectrum communications are considered.

articleTitle: Conversion of business-processes of extended BPMN into BPEL code
abstract: This paper presents a modified method of a conversion of graphical business processes (BPMN) and its extension BPNE into execution business processes (BPEL). Problems of BPMN-BPEL conversion is overviewed and a structure of the software implementation that implements the proposed method.

articleTitle: Structural functions of electromagnetic coupling of the magnetodielectric sphere resonance crystal
abstract: Plotting of structure functions of electromagnetic interaction of electric and magnetic types for limited 3D orthogonal resonant gratings from small magnetodielectric spheres in the external homogeneous magnetodielectric environment is considered.

articleTitle: Photonic crystal waveguides in O-type electron devices
abstract: Spatial distribution of the TM modes electromagnetic field in the photonic crystal fibers cross sections is investigated. Existence of the confined modes with field intensity maximum at the waveguides center allows forming channels for sheet and pencil electron beams. This scheme can be used for development of the terahertz multi-beam O-type electron devices.

articleTitle: K-band 0.25 μm GaN HEMT
abstract: DC and RF performances of 0.25 μm GaN HEMT on sapphire with T-shaped gate (W<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf> = 8×50 μm) based on the AlGaN/AlN/GaN heterostructure are presented. The measured figures of merit are f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">T</inf> = 31 GHz and f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> = 60 GHz. A transistor's small signal equivalent circuit is extracted.

articleTitle: Genetic-algorithm based synthesis of microwave amplifiers using parametric models of MMIC elements
abstract: The modified genetic-algorithm-based technique for automated synthesis of MMIC linear and low noise amplifiers (LNAs) is presented. It allows using directly the parametric equivalent-circuit models for MMIC passive elements. The technique is implemented in GENEAMP software tool. An example design of 2-10 GHz single-stage feedback MMIC LNA is demonstrated. Five practical LNA schematics have been generated within several minutes.

articleTitle: RF moisture measurement of concrete with a resonator sensor
abstract: Non-destructive methods are becoming more and more crucial in the evaluation of concrete in construction engineering and also for needs analysis of renovation in old targets. When detecting of the possible water leaks inside concrete the non-destructive methods provide undisputedly the best means when houses are evaluated. In this paper a feasibility study of moisture measurement of concrete with the RF resonator sensor method is carried out. The resonator method is based on the resonant frequency shift when the permittivity of the material under test (MUT) increases with growing water content. A concrete sample is measured when it is completely dry and when it has been saturated in tap water and at 21 saturation levels until a completely dry state. The results indicate that the used resonator is sensitive enough for the moisture measurement of the concrete in question. The effect of the moisture content of the sample on the resonant frequency shift is studied by measurements. The dependency between the resonant frequency shift and the moisture content is determined.

articleTitle: Current transport mechanisms in anisotype heterojunctions n-CdO/p-Si
abstract: n-CdO/p-Si heterojunction was prepared by means of the deposition of a cadmium oxide thin film (with n-type of conductivity) onto a polished polycrystalline silicon substrate (p-type of conductivity) using the spray-pyrolysis technique. I-V characteristics of the heterojunction were measured at different temperatures and the dominating current transport mechanisms were established at forward and reverse biases.

articleTitle: Estimation of phase synchronization in symmetric EEG channels
abstract: The problem of determining the symmetry of the brain electrical activity is considered. The new quantitative measure of symmetry in brain electrical activity for two hemispheres is proposed on the basis of mean values of phase synchronization for real and surrogate EEG. Experimental results of measuring symmetry of electroencephalographic signals from healthy and epileptic persons are presented, showing substantial differences in synchronicity revealed for two cases.

articleTitle: Design of compact wide-band coaxial-to-waveguide microwave transitions
abstract: A novel compact wide-band coaxial-to-waveguide transition between a standard rectangular waveguide and 50-Ohm coaxial line is designed. The prototypes of transitions for X- and Ku- band are successfully fabricated and tested. The measured VSWR is less than 1.22 for 8...12 GHz transition and VSWR is less than 1.2 for 12...18 GHz coaxial-to-waveguide transition, respectively.

articleTitle: Models of code-combinations enumeration and generation processes for solving network problems
abstract: Mathematical models of codes-combinations enumeration and generation processes on the basis of the developed binomial mappings are proposed in the paper. The binomial mappings use binomial numbers, which determine a structure of the considered codes.

articleTitle: Methods and algorithms of correction of propagation factor influence on errors of measurement coordinates receivers GNSS
abstract: The approaches reducing influence of the propagation conditions on measurement accuracy of coordinates by receivers of global navigation satellite systems (GNSS) are considered. Using experimental data on coordinates of measuring points, possibility of introduction of mistakes correction because of the propagation conditions are estimated.

articleTitle: Arsenide galium nanostructural diode with nonresonant tunneling
abstract: The low-signal impedance of a microwave diode on AlGaAs/GaAs nanostructure with electron tunnel injection through AlGaAs potential barrier and transit in GaAs drift layer is investigated. Frequency dependences of the impedance at width and height of a barrier layer of 2.5 nm and 0.3 eV is studied at different diode diameter and transit angle values. Maximal negative conductance of 192 mS is reached for the diode with both optimal diameter of 25 μm and transit angle of 1.1 π.

articleTitle: Combining of methods providing synchronization of the base stations at different hierarchical levels of a network with packet commutation
abstract: The combined use of methods for providing the synchronization at different hierarchical levels of a network with packet commutation: basic network (core), aggregating and access, is shown. The results of experimental research are shown.

articleTitle: Distribution of EM power absorption in geometric models of human parts
abstract: In this study, we take into consideration two significant steps. First of them is calculating of scattering and absorption energy values of specific geometric models. For different geometric shapes there are different exact formulations which the solutions come from Maxwell Equations. There are important points which we become familiar with this study about the propagation characteristics of EM waves. Second step of our project is the determination of heat distribution characteristic in our specific spherical model. The simulation of graphs are illustrated the results.

articleTitle: Correction of color digital TV images recorded in bad weather
abstract: The method of correction of digital television images recorded in bad weather, that can be applied both to monochrome and color images, is presented.

articleTitle: Remote effects of electromagnetic millimeter waves on experimentally induced cold pain — A crossover double-blinded investigation in healthy volunteers
abstract: The hypoalgesic effect of millimeter waves (MW) was studied using experimental pain model of Cold Pressor Test (CPT) in healthy volunteers. Skin of the lower part of sternum of each volunteer was exposed to either source of MW with 42.25 GHz ("fixed frequency" generator), 50-75 GHz ("noise frequency" generator) or inactive device ("placebo" generator) in a random order. Pain threshold, pain tolerance and diastolic blood pressure within CPT increased under the exposure to "frequency generator" as compared to baseline and to "noise" generator, but not vs. placebo.

articleTitle: Phase delay distribution in dome lens antenna with displaced feed array
abstract: A method for calculating the phase delay distribution in a dome lens antenna with a displaced feed array is described. The problem for dome lenses in the form of a spherical enclosure of infinitely small or preset thickness with forced beam refraction has been formulated as solved.

articleTitle: Current status and prospects of atmosphere radiosounding systems
abstract: Historical background is given, the analysis of current state is performed and the ways of further development of atmosphere radiosounding systems are presented. Alongside with the prospects, the advisability of developing and implementing the digital mobile system using the signals of satellite navigation GLONASS/GPS platform for tracking radiosounding and determining its location, as well as direction and speed of wind is pointed out. Another prospect deals with the modernization of existing systems through the use of microwave autodyne oscillators as miniature and low-cost transceivers - the responder of request radar signals.

articleTitle: Phase-shift keyed signal compression using a mismatched sidelobe-free filter in the presence of Doppler frequency shift
abstract: Analysis of the influence of the Doppler frequency shift on the effectiveness of Barker code compression is carried out. The mismatched sidelobe-free filter was considered as a signal compression filter. An ambiguity function of the mismatched filter was constructed, comparative analysis of ambiguity functions of the mismatched filter and a conventional matched filter was performed.

articleTitle: MPLS overlay network synthesis method with multilayer graph usage
abstract: It is suggested to use multi-layer graphs as a mathematical model in the design of MPLS networks. The application of this model makes it possible to design multi-service telecommunication systems simultaneously at several levels and reduce the problem to the search of the minimum weight graph.

articleTitle: Anisotropic dielectric substrate as thin dielectric resonator
abstract: Dielectric resonances of thin anisotropic substrates are analyzed. It is shown that substrate orientation in a cylindrical shielding cavity influences the field distribution, coupling and excitation conditions, resonance frequency and quality factor of its TE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01δ</inf> resonance mode. The HE<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11δ</inf> mode is split in two resonances whose intensities depend on substrate orientation and thickness. The optimal ways of anisotropic substrate parameters characterization are discussed.

articleTitle: Synthesis of InSb nanowires in anodic alumina modified matrixes
abstract: The methods of formation of modified anodic alumina matrixes (AAM) without barrier layer with metal, semiconductor and metal-oxide conductive contacts in the bottom side of pores has been developed. Semiconductor InSb nanostructures were selectively grown in modified AAM-template using electrochemical deposition on these contacts. Investigations of structure of formed InSb nanowires arrays have been performed.

articleTitle: Simulation of single-electron 2D arrays and resonant-tunneling diode using modified models
abstract: Nanoelectronic devices based on the effects of single-electron and resonant tunneling are analyzed. Current-voltage characteristics of single-electron 2D arrays and resonant-tunneling diode (RTD) are calculated using modified models.

articleTitle: Simulation of 180-GHz orbictron-amplifier
abstract: The construction of two-stage millimeter-wave orbictron-amplifier, a mathematical model and computational procedures are briefly described. The calculations of two 180Ghz amplifier embodiments including the resonance dimensions of a binary comb are presented. It is shown that the orbictron-amplifier delivers a 10% efficiency with the following parameters the electro-dynamic system loaded Q-factor 800; 3 kV operating voltage; 0.1 A operating current. The device in question is characterized by a 34 dB gain, 16 W output power with an input power of 0.006 W.

articleTitle: Adaptation simulation of the wireless sensor network with routing based on the geometry of force lines of potential field in the presence of interference source
abstract: Simulation results for wireless massively dense sensor network with different methods of interference source adaptation to the presence of interference source is presented.

articleTitle: Specialized multiprobe multimeters in technological high power microwave plants
abstract: There was developed criteria for creation of specialized multimeters on the base of analysis of microwave generators in the technological plants.

articleTitle: Wireless terahertz low power UWB communications
abstract: UWB terahertz communication link at 70 microwatt transmit power is proposed for wireless personal area networks. The noise performance is presented.

articleTitle: Phase shifters based on split strip lines
abstract: The discrete phase shifter with increased reliability and power based on the split strip transmission line (SSL) is developed. The series-parallel circuit of switching diodes connection with strips of split strip line on DC in phase shifter device was used. We obtained a phase shift of 180 degrees and losses <;1.5 dB in the frequency range of 3:1.

articleTitle: Influence of porphine derivatives molecular structure on their supramolecular organization in floating layers and Langmuir-Blodgett films
abstract: In order to study the influence of molecular structure features on their supramolecular organization in the floating layers and thin films 15 new meso-substituted tetraphenylporphine derivatives and their metal complexes with substitution in para- or ortho-positions (-OC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub> or -OC<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">16</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">33</sub>) were investigated. Methods full-scale modeling of supramolecular organization of the compounds in the floating layers was performed using molecular mechanics and molecular dynamics. The dependence of supra-molecular organization of floating layers and thin films from the structure of the porphines was studied.

articleTitle: Using artificial neural networks for development of microwave devices
abstract: The advantages of neural networks application for the development of microwave devices are considered. Expedience of problems solution related to the approximation peculiarities of the microwave devices characteristics using neural networks ensemble is validated. Ensemble architecture for characteristics approximation is proposed.

articleTitle: A new pulse splitter based on coupled lines
abstract: A new schematic and a design of the pulse splitter, which based on coupled lines, are presented. The device allows splitting an ultra short (less than 1 ns) input pulse into two output subpulses of an equal amplitude.

articleTitle: Formation of microwave signals with small step of frequencies grid
abstract: The method of forming of microwave signals with a small step of frequencies grid and improved noise characteristics is considered. This method is applicable to measurement technique, and also it solves problems of telecommunication, increasing the number of channel in microwave band.

articleTitle: The influence of metal screen upon electrodynamic parameters of connected dielectric waveguides
abstract: The electrodynamic characteristics of a directional coupler model with distributed coupling and a metal screen were analyzed. The recommendations of using of such practical devices, circuits and electronics technology in the microwave and optical range were given.

articleTitle: The characteristics of disk radiator with slot discontinuity
abstract: The results of experimental investigations of the characteristics of a disk radiator with single radial slot discontinuity. The experimental results in the form of pattern characteristics, ellipticity coefficient and VSWR allow stating that this structure is a multiband antenna with quasi-circular polarization.

articleTitle: Challenges and prospects of A3B5 microvawe foundry
abstract: Current results obtained by JSC “Svetlana-Rost”, while developing full-cycle foundry service for Russian market, are presented. Standard technologies with crucial dimension of 0.5 micron, examples of microwave devices and acoustic resonators realization are presented.

articleTitle: Development of Lo circuit for transmitter in 126–134 GHz band
abstract: Output part of the LO circuit has been developed for transceiver operating in frequency band 126…134 GHz. The circuit contains multiplying and amplifying stages with selective filters, and a power splitter for transmission and receiving channels.

articleTitle: Determination of character of the interactions of signals response in nonlinear radar
abstract: The problem of determination of combined response signal (RS) from the obstacle nonlinear scatterers (NS) by a special system of preliminary nonlinear sounding (SPNS) in nonlinear radar is examined. The investigation of interaction of the components of combined RS from the obstacle NS, which arbitrarily spread in space and have different scattering capability is done. It is shown that for the definition with certain confidence probability the character of the components interactions of combined RS from the obstacle NS, its necessary jointly to analyze the efficiency of exposure the receiving response signals by three methods - χ<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-test, coordinated processing of signals and "max-λ" test.

articleTitle: The analytical approximation of measuring dependences of resonator probes for scanning microwave microscopy
abstract: The characteristics of conversion of coaxial resonator probes with a measuring aperture were investigated. Approximate expressions were obtained.

articleTitle: Influence of construction parameters of cross-field devices resonant structure on quality factors
abstract: Quality factors of magnetron resonant structure via geometrical parameters were analyzed. Using the oven magnetron as a base it was defined the influence of geometrical parameters on quality factors in particular neighbouring mode separation.

articleTitle: 3-D simulation OF 32 GHz cold cathode magnetron operating in the (+1)-st space harmonic of π-mode oscillations
abstract: An analytic estimate has been made of the optimal parameters of a pulsed cold secondary-emission cathode magnetron operating at a frequency of 32 GHz with anode voltage of 8 kV and magnetic field of 0.4 T. The magnetron interaction space geometry facilitates the interplay of electrons and the microwave-field of the (-1)-st space harmonic of π/2-mode oscillations. The numerical experiment involving the use of a 3-D model has been performed to see whether the magnetrons with analytically specified parameters are capable of operating required energy characteristics. We have provided ample evidence of the opportunity to engineer the type of a magnetron, which can be efficiently operated with relatively lower anode voltages, acceptable magnetic field, energy parameter and maximum lifetime. All these operational features will open new fields of applications in marine radar transmitters. Specifically, they will be able to address a series of specific problems at surveillance stations and to monitor the movements of small-size above-water objects, navigational aspects of high-speed hydrofoil vessels, ground-effect crafts. In addition, all the above features will beneficial in terms of piloting all kinds of vessels in the open waters close to the ports' coastal areas where navigation is intensive (the navigation traffic is heavy).

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of frequency-selective structures
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical modeling of the structure composed of spirals winding in different directions. It is shown that this structure has frequency-selective properties and allows controlling the behavior of the reflected wave.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of millimeter range electromagnetic radiation influence on the growth processes of the micromycetes
abstract: The growth processes of the micromycetes under influence of high-frequency and low intensity electromagnetic radiation are investigated. The possibility of considerable stimulation of the radial growth rate of the micromycetes under electromagnetic radiation influence of extremely high frequencies with power flow density of 10 microwatt/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> has been discovered. The possible mechanisms of such stimulation as well as ecological and medical aspects of the discovered phenomenon are discussed.

articleTitle: Development and investigation of low-pass filter MIC with a wide stop-band
abstract: The monolithic integrated circuit of quasi-lumped element low-pass filter has been developed and investigated. The circuit has a form of a suspended coplanar line based on a defected ground structure (DGS). The detail analysis of the filter equivalent circuit has been used to optimize its parameters. The stop-band of low-pass filter exceeds 100 GHz. The filter dimensions are (0.9 × 0.6) mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Prototype of radio signal retransmission system of digital satellite TV broadcasting in 11 GHz band to be used in higher education training
abstract: The design principles and creation experience of DVB-S digital satellite television radiosignal retransmitter prototype (RP) for 11 GHz for the purpose of students' education improving during digital television discipline studying in Institute of Telecommunication Systems of NTUU “KPI” are shown.

articleTitle: Factors reducing the cutoff frequency of resonant-tunneling diode
abstract: Cutoff frequency of resonant tunneling diodes (RTD's) designed for operation in millimeter wave subharmonic mixers is analyzed and investigated. The delay of electrons in the RTD quantum well and localized electron states at heterointerfaces of RTD active layers are observed experimentally.

articleTitle: Modelling of transfer processes in heterostructures with plasma waves at low temperatures
abstract: Presented in this paper is the research of basic scattering mechanisms in semiconductor heterostructures, as well as basic characteristics of transfer processes at space charge mode using statistical modeling technique. Outstanding feature of this method is statistic modeling and self-consistent solution of hydrodynamic model equation, that allowed us to define the basic physical mechanisms, that determine the raising of plasma waves expansion velocity and to determine the requirements for the choice of electrophysical parameters of heterostructures in order to obtain terahertz band oscillations.

articleTitle: Generation and signal processing methods in MIMO communication systems on channels with ISI
abstract: This paper concerns modification of algorithms for calculation QR and SVD decomposition of polynomial matrix into matrix with elements in the form of rational functions, which is equivalent to the use of IIR, instead of FIR filters in the suitable procedures of processing and generation of the signal. The proposed approach can reduce calculating cost of decomposition procedure and further signal processing, primarily by reducing the degree of polynomials, which form the elements of the resultant matrix, which is equivalent to the reduction of memory interval of virtual subchannels. This method is based on the polynomial version of QR algorithm and the procedure of Bauer factorization.

articleTitle: Approximation of the current-voltage characteristics of Gunn diodes
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental researches of the current voltage characteristics of Gunn diodes are presented. On the results of research, an analytical expression describing the current voltage characteristics of Gunn diodes in the continuous and pulse operation modes are obtained. Based on the description of the current voltage characteristics the dependence on the microwave power on the continuous or surge voltage of driving of the Gunn diode is obtained.

articleTitle: Resonance frequency of Gunn diodes based on А3В5 graded-gap semiconductors
abstract: Dependence of resonance frequency of current oscillations generated by Gunn diodes (TED) on the basis of graded gap semiconductors on length of the graded gap layer (l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">V</sub>), active region length (l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">a</sub>) and the voltage (U) applied to the diode is determined. The studies have been carried out using three-level model of intervalley electron transfer (IET) in the graded gap semiconductor.

articleTitle: Propagation of polarized radiation in a seawater-like scattering medium
abstract: The regularities of change elements of the matrix transformation in scattering media from its optical-geometrical coordinates outside the geometric area of the beam were studied in the present paper. On the basis of this investigation we can estimate it. In the coordinate system of the optical thickness along the beam propagation direction and in the orthogonal direction of a light field in the scattering medium (outside the exploratory beam), the points with maximum values of the light beam intensity and the degree of linear polarization coincide with each other. Outside the beam geometric area, the increase of absorption in the medium leads to the decrease in the maximum of the total intensity from the optical thickness and the shift of the location of the maximum towards larger ones. Zone of the light beam from which the maximum intensity of the scattered light is realized has a clearly determined optical coordinate depending on the geometry of the experiment.

articleTitle: Digital beam forming by means of matrix Fourier transform method
abstract: This article describes the procedure of digital beam forming, which allows expanding the bandwidth of the digital antenna array. The method is based on matrix representation of the discrete Fourier transform.

articleTitle: The review of transponders for the system of objects positioning
abstract: Two variants of scheme design of transponders for the system of objects positioning were considered. The first approach is based on the using of a circulator, a band-pass filter and a microwave amplifier, which is associated with the number of shortcomings. The second type of transponder is based on a regenerative amplifier, which simplifies the design and denies shortcomings of the first approach to the transponder design. A comparative analysis of two types of transponders was made.

articleTitle: Application of compensation of temperature interferences at geoelectric sounding of the karst
abstract: The algorithm of geoelectric sounding data processing, allowing reducing influence of temperature interferences on results of measurements, is offered.

articleTitle: Maintenance of serviceability of integrated circuits at radiation influence
abstract: A number of the developed methods of maintenance of radiation resistance of integrated circuits (BiCMOS and CMOS) is submitted.

articleTitle: Use of the carbon-containing materials for reduction in the reflections of the electromagnetic radiations
abstract: By means of the model of two-layered coverage it was shown the difference in the effects of interaction of electromagnetic radiation with the conducting carbon-containing materials, located on the dielectric and metallic substrates. The calculated dependences of the absorption coefficients on the wavelength, conductivity and thickness of samples are given.

articleTitle: The scattering parameter microstrip traveling-wave directional filters
abstract: A principle of the microstrip directional traveling-wave filters (MDFTW) scattering parameters formation is discussed and justified on the basis of its known flow diagram. The S-matrix of microstrip directional filter is shown.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet photodiodes with enhanceable short-wave sensitiveness for biological researches
abstract: The method of computer design showed, that a photodiode of type UFD-04-16 on the basis of selenide of zinc at the thickness of a barrier layer of nickel 10 nm can have current monochromatic sensitiveness on the wave-length 250 nm to 0.6 A/W, that makes it possible to use it for detection of mitogenetic radiation.

articleTitle: Optimization of the microstrip hairpin filters with slots in the ground plane
abstract: An algorithm for optimizing microstrip hairpin bandpass filter, based on quasi-static analysis of the cross-section of coupled-line sections and genetic algorithm to find solutions was developed. Optimization of microstrip hairpin bandpass filter with slots in the ground plane to reduce the insertion losses in the HFSS has been proposed.

articleTitle: Design of millimeter range generator for biomedical appliances
abstract: A mathematical model of generators with electrical tuning of frequency is considered. Experimental verification of the model is carried out.

articleTitle: Compatibility analysis of standards of the digital on-air broadcasting of DVB-T and DVB-T2
abstract: The paper describes the results of compatibility analysis of DVT-T and DVB-T2 (the two generations of digital terrestrial television broadcasting standards). They both do not provide defined schemas of transmitters and receivers, so the problem of simultaneous operation of these two standards is quite urgent. The analysis of a functional schema of the equipment and computer simulation of their operation was carried out in order to study it. The paper reviews key distinctive and similar principles of the equipment for digital television designing. The study is based on technical features of described standards and embedded innovations.

articleTitle: Construction architecture of digital TV units
abstract: The present paper concerns the architecture of four digital TV units on the base of which Beta TV com Enterprise produces equipment of DVB-C, S, T signal forming.

articleTitle: Intraband absorption in quantum dots
abstract: This paper presents a model for calculating the optical absorption spectrum of quantum dots for cases of strong and weak spatial constraints. This model agrees well with experimental data and can be used in mathematical models describing the operation of photovoltaic cells based on quantum dots.

articleTitle: Double screen of finite thickness with coaxial-sector waveguides
abstract: The electrodynamic characteristics of a double screen of finite thickness with coaxial-sector waveguides are investigated. Frequency dependences of the reflection coefficient are presented for the case of normal incidence of a plane electromagnetic wave upon the double screen. The reflection coefficient is calculated in dependence on the polarization of the incident wave.

articleTitle: Dynamic autodyne features of microwave generators
abstract: The paper presnts the results of dynamic characteristics analysis of microwave oscillators under the influence of radiation reflected from moving objects. We derived expressions for the frequency dependence of the autodyne gain constant, frequency deviation and autodetection signal taking into account the internal parameters of generators and the velocity of reflecting objects. Their behavior peculiarities, which depend on the autodyne signal frequency, are based on the results of numerical calculations of the characteristics.

articleTitle: The principle of constructing coherent pulse high duty-factor radar
abstract: An unconventional principle of a constructing coherent pulse high duty-factor radar is described. It is shown that the function circuit of the coherent pulse radars that were built around the structural concept already described does not involve the phasing of a heterodyne reference signal.

articleTitle: Microwave athermal annealing of composite matherials
abstract: Endothermic reactions were observed as a result of low-power microwave radiation. Composite microhardness changed because of structure relaxation of intergranular ordering.

articleTitle: Optimization of Schottky diode multiplier of millimeter wavelength range
abstract: It was shown that profile optimization of substrate doping of Schottky multiplier diode allows not only increasing significantly the capacity overlap coefficient K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">CB</inf>>4.5, but also providing the minimum value of leakage current over the range (0–10 V) of reverse biases. With the use of AFM has been shown one of the possible statistically ideal states of the epitaxial n-GaAs surface, which allows obtaining M-P contacts in millimeter range with the idealness index n <1.1 and the series resistance R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</inf><10 ohms. Minimization of parasitic parameters due to the use of air bridges allowed obtaining Schottky mixer diodes with the overlap coefficient K<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cd</inf>> 3.3.

articleTitle: Formation of aluminium porous structures under conditions of quasi-equilibrium condensation
abstract: In present work a new concept of high porous metals structures formation is described, which is based on condensation of ion-sputtered substance near the thermodynamical equilibrium. We have analyzed advantages of the technological systems with self-organisation of critically small supersaturations of depositing fluxes together with accumulation of a substance near a growth surface.

articleTitle: Load decrease of the data transfer in geoelectric monitoring system
abstract: The article analyses the operation of the system for geoelectrical monitoring of geodynamic objects. It presents the developed method of decrease of redundancy of information in the transmitted data to improve the efficiency of handling the probing signal and the receipt of predictive assessments.

articleTitle: Method of increasing the wireless ad hoc network throughput
abstract: The method of increasing the wireless ad hoc network throughput based on the UAV placement control in view of the rapid and unpredictable movement of mobile subscribers is proposed.

articleTitle: Diminutive uhf filters and deplexer of satellite radio navigation GPS-GLONASS systems
abstract: The new filters and duplexers for satellite radio navigation system based on low and high pass filter are presented. Each filter has the broad stopband and low signal power losses in the passband. Location of the bands is chosen to cover the GPS and GLONASS ranges L1 and L2 and provide resolution between each other. In the article the plots characteristics of diplexers and filters transmission gain are presented as well as their topology.

articleTitle: The scattering properties of bio-objects under the influence of non-harmonic signals
abstract: The model of EPR of the human body under the effect of non-harmonic signals is proposed.

articleTitle: Practical realization of digital compensation of nonlinearity of the bridging amplifier in TV signal transmitter DVB-T
abstract: The paper presents the practical results of the previously proposed technical solution of digital compensation of nonlinearity of the bridging amplifier in TV signal transmitter DVB-T [1], taking into account the influence of imperfections of analog radiopaths.

articleTitle: Improvement of service development approaches
abstract: All the stages of service lifecycle are briefly discussed. Gaps in the state-of-the-art in the fields of workflows design, their transformation from one notation into another, their analysis, monitoring and re-configuration are also considered. Main methodological solutions for closing the discovered gaps are proposed.

articleTitle: Method for amplitude-phase error assessment of four-port microwave network complex transmission and reflection coefficient measurement devices
abstract: A novel method for amplitude-phase error assessment for four-port microwave network complex transmission and reflection coefficient measurement devices is proposed. The core of this method lies in the idea that amplitude dynamic range of a microwave network analyzer could be divided by equal amplitude sub-ranges, afterwards the complex amplification coefficients in each sub-range are measured, and after all the quantities are compared with ideal complex quantities in amplitude and phase.

articleTitle: Monitoring determination of waterlogged soil areas with aircraft observations in IR and microwave bands
abstract: The paper presents the analyzed results of integrated monitoring of lands underfloodings manifestations by the side-looking Ka-band radar, an aerial camera and IR scanner of the remote sensing aviation complex ACRS-30.

articleTitle: Carriers localisation in the multilayer nanostructures stipulated by interference redislocation of wave functions
abstract: The possibility to determine the eigenvalues and eigenfunctions of particles and quasi particles in the tunnel-linked quantum wells in the perturbations theory approximation is considered. The given approach makes it possible to describe the process of interaction between the quantum wells more adequately, particularly in the case when increasing the width and energy height of the dividing barrier.

articleTitle: Efficient algorithm for numerical integration of motion equations of large particles in microwave devices
abstract: The efficient algorithm for solving the equations of motion of large particles in the microwave devices is presented.

articleTitle: Printed circuit antenna array with integrated power dividing systems
abstract: The X-band printed circuit antenna array with a fixed amplitude and phase distribution and design description are proposed. Technological justification for the developed scheme features is presented. The design alternative of the radiated aperture and stand-alone power dividing systems (PDS) in vertical and horizontal planes in a multilayer make it possible to develop antenna of different width for a relatively low construction weight.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillators characteristics in case of reflection coefficient modulation
abstract: The results of analysis of microwave oscillator modulation characteristics modulated by reflection-coefficient modulus changes are presented. We derived expressions and plotted graphs of modulation rate frequency dependence based on changing the amplitude, frequency, and an autodetection signal of a microwave oscillator. Their behavior peculiarities, which depend on the modulation frequency, are based on the results of numerical calculations of the characteristics.

articleTitle: Effect of mercury vapor on characteristics of plasma space vehicles antenna
abstract: The influence of mercury vapor in the plasma antennas on their electrical properties is estimated.

articleTitle: Theoretical grounds of autodyne method of forming response signals of a radiosonde for distance measurements
abstract: This report describes the operation principle and block diagram of the autodyne transceiver proposed for the atmosphere radio probing system. The transceiver has better electromagnetic compatibility as compared with currently used superregenerative devices. There are theoretical investigation results of the autodyne operating mode as a receiver of signals from a requesting radar.

articleTitle: Stroboscopic processing of a coherent broadband RF signal pack
abstract: Stroboscopic transformation of periodic RF radar signals in close-range location problems is inspected. It is shown that with stroboscopic processing of a pack of radar impulses the side lobes of the indeterminacy function in the application area can be suppressed by selecting the shape of the signal.

articleTitle: Theory and practice of construction of stealth Rayleigh Wi-Fi channels
abstract: The report investigates the ways to improve the stealth Wi-Fi Rayleigh channels, the level of which is characterized by a probability of detection P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">05</sub>. As a result of the work a more advanced model for calculating the value of P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">05</sub>, the method of calculation of the detection zone and a new way to improve the stealth channel due to its work under artificial noise, are offered.

articleTitle: Unification of approaches for developing intelligent systems for Internet
abstract: Principles of developing intelligent systems for Internet are proposed. It is based on graphodinamical models rep-resentations and processing of information. Approaches for jumping from its models to Semantic web's models are shown.

articleTitle: The study of shielding characteristics of composites on the basis of cement and schungite
abstract: The technology for manufacturing of composite materials on the basis of cement and shungite, which can be used as finishing materials for providing electromagnetic compatibility of electronic equipment, protect information from leaking via electromagnetic radiation channels. The study of the characteristics of shielding materials was carried out with panoramic measurer of transmission and reflection coefficients. It is shown that the material on the basis of cement and schungite is characterized by the values of transmission coefficients from −10 dB to −30 dB in the frequency range 0.5–18 GHz.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of spectral characteristics of total interference signal from the group of LTE mobile stations
abstract: Experimental researches of total interference signal of the group user stations of LTE network fragment is carried out. The presented results of experimental investigations of spectral characteristics of total interference signal of the group user stations support the suggestion that dynamic varying interference from a group of user's stations in a neighborhood of one base station can be substituted with equivalent interference with the uniform spectral power.

articleTitle: Conception of intellectual control systems hierarchic construction for tactical MANET's
abstract: The hierarchical construction model of the tactical radio networks intellectual control systems is presented in the article. A model allows realizing decomposition of mobile radio networks operative management tasks on the recursive sequence of components: tasks related to node management and its adaptation to the different operating conditions are solved at the node level; planning and mobile radio network management tasks are solved at the network level.

articleTitle: Development of narrow-band filters in a range from 6 TO 10 GHz on LTCC ceramics manufactured by FSUE RPC “Istok”
abstract: The paper presents the results of researches concerning possibility of development of high-Q resonators and narrow-band filters based on in-house LTCC ceramics of Federal State Unitary Enterprise "Research and Production Corporation "Istok" in a solid version. Main parameters of in-house LTCC ceramics of FSUE "Istok" and analogous brands of ceramics of world's leading manufacturers are briefly reported.

articleTitle: Resonance near-field microwave probing of pathological processes in skin tissues
abstract: A method for noninvasive diagnostic of skin tissues by means of resonance near-field microwave probing is proposed and tested.

articleTitle: Effectiveness improvement of phase-shift keyed signal compression using Compensation of signal distortion in receiving and transmitting path of radar
abstract: Analysis of the impact of distortions in receiving and transmitting path of the radar on the performance characteristics of Barker code compression is carried out. The investigation of performance characteristics of Barker code compression by a mismatched filter in the presence of signal distortions is performed.

articleTitle: New approach to using elliptic curve transformations for security of ad hoc networks
abstract: The present paper describes the method which is used to transform an elliptical curve for a random number generator. This method allows one to increase the number of generator inner states. The restoration of the generation law tends to get complicated as the number of inner states increases The spin-off of the present work is the obtained lower boundary of a pseudorandom bit sequence period.

articleTitle: Fast fourier transform algorithm optimization for Sandy Bridge processor architecture in respect to spaceborne SAR digital radiohologram processing
abstract: FFT calculation is one of the most burdensome problems in large-sized digital radiohologram processing, the rate being limited by DRAM throughput and latency. The proposed algorithm improves efficiency of using Sandy Bridge processor cache memory due to memory access rate reduction.

articleTitle: Terbium photo-, cathodo- and X-ray luminescence in sol-gel derived films in porous anodic alumina
abstract: Photo-, cathodo-, and X-ray luminescence of terbium in sol-gel derived films, fabricated in porous anodic alumina is studied. The cell size of the fabricated film convertor of irradiation is about 250 nm. The methods of increase Tb luminescence under diverse excitation conditions are discussed.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistive properties of ordered arrays of Fe3O4 and FeO nanoparticles
abstract: The complex investigation of the properties of spin-valve system fragments based on ordered arrays of iron oxide nanoparticles embedded into the conductive matrix were conducted. The influence of the external magnetic field geometry on the magnetoresistance and coercive force value were analyzed. The phase-structural, electrical and morphological properties were studied.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic waves penetration through the nonuniform biisotropic partition in a cylindrical waveguide
abstract: The numerical solution procedure of the boundary problem of the penetration of the symmetric electromagnetic waves of a round perfectly conducting waveguide through a biisotropic partition is developed. The opportunity of transformation of E-waves in H-waves, and on the contrary, is found out at passage through a biisotropic partition. The electrodynamic properties of chiral axially non-uniform partitions are analyzed.

articleTitle: Microwave image forming by means of ring aperture
abstract: Microwave imaging system with ring aperture is considered. Image reconstruction algorithm for this system is described, and the resolution of the system is investigated.

articleTitle: The optimization of electrodynamic characteristics of slow wave structure “comb quad”
abstract: The results of the electrodynamic characteristics study of the slow-wave structure "comb-quad" when you change its basic size and shape are presented. The optimization of the cavity shape allowed increasing the coupling impedance of the working harmonics and finding the desired slope of the dispersion characteristics, providing suppression of self-excitation in the short boundary.

articleTitle: Wideband L-band circular-polarized feeding antenna for radiotelescope RT-7.5
