abstract: Wideband (WB) L-band circular-polarized feeding antenna for the parabolic reflector of radiotelecope RT-7.5 BMSTU was developed. Device's construction is detailed. Simulation results exploiting FEM are presented and discussed.

articleTitle: 30–40 GHz control GaAs MMIC
abstract: The designed and fabricated SPDT and 6-bit attenuator MMIC's based on 0.8 μm GaAs MESFET technology are presented.

articleTitle: Magnetoresistive and magnetooptical characteristics of nanoscale systems on the basis of Fe and Co
abstract: Magnetoresistive (MR) and magnetooptical properties (Kerr effect - MOKE) were investigated for nanoscale film systems on the basis of Fe and Co using different substrates (Si/SiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, MgO), annealing temperatures (300, 500, 800°C) and layer thickness. It was found that during epitaxial film growth with MgO as a substrate there is significant magnetic anisotropy that causes the increase of coercitivity in two times (for MgO/Fe(30 nm)/Co(30 nm)) and significant MR variation for different sample's turn angle.

articleTitle: Fluctuation properties of coherent oscillator system of time and frequency synchronizing
abstract: Investigation of filtering properties of the PLL with a fixed transfer function analytically and the use of digitizing an analog signal allow investigating the filter properties of the system as the mathematical simulation of the reference and output signal.

articleTitle: Downconverter modelling with subharmonically pumped diode mixer and F-class power amplifier
abstract: Annotation - Modeling of downconverter with the RF input of 63.8 GHz and its components was conducted, including 63.8GHz subharmonically pumped (SHP) diode mixer and 5.8GHz F-class power amplifier (PA) based on metamaterials with gain equal 11.8 dB. This downconverter is a dual down-conversion system. The intermediate frequencies equal 5.8GHz and 70 MHz correspondingly. The proposed mixer utilizes a pair of anti-parallel diodes to achieve a subharmonic mixing mechanism and is composed of a coplanar diplexer, LO coplanar filter, RF band-pass filter (BPF) and intermediate frequency (IF) low-pass filter (LPF). The diplexer is used to improve the isolation between the radio frequency (RF) and local oscillation (LO) ports. The IF LPF filter supports an IF that equals 5.8 GHz. The conversion loss at LO power level of 10 dBm constitutes -21.09 dB, the LO-to-RF and RF-to-IF isolation are -12 and - 21 dB, respectively.

articleTitle: The radiating unit based on hybrid metal-dielectric structure with bounded sequence of transverse slots
abstract: The radiating unit based on hybrid metaldielectric structure with an inverted dielectric waveguide as a basis is investigated. The bounded sequence of transverse equidistant arranged slots in metal microstrip conductor on upper plane of dielectric substrate is used as radiators. The possibility of changing the pattern characteristic from one-lobe directional diagram to two-lobe one is shown.

articleTitle: Experimental research of the field structure in a slotted resonator
abstract: The results of experimental research of the electromagnetic field structure in a slotted resonator using the method of a magnetic probe on the basis of ferromagnetic resonance are introduced.

articleTitle: Microstrip antenna with enhanced passband
abstract: The technique for matching input impedance of a microstrip antenna (MSA) is proposed. The structure of three-element modified Chebychev network, where the first element is the antenna itself is designed. A comparison of the typical MSA and antenna with integrated coplanar matching network is performed.

articleTitle: Inertia navigational fiber-optical block with the signal GPS-correction for the platform gyro-stabilization
abstract: The inertia navigational block has been designed with GPS correction, using the fiber-optical gyroscopes as the sensors of the angular displacements. The peculiar feature of the inertia navigational block is the dual module design structure, comprising the module of the sensitive elements, mounted directly on the stabilized platform, and the auxiliary module, comprising the special computing device, GPS receiver and the secondary supply sources. Such separation made it possible to reduce the weight-dimensional indicators of the platform, to facilitate its mechanical matching with the air-photo-equipment.

articleTitle: Geodynamic objects electromagnetic probing at the account of external natural interferences
abstract: In this work interaction processes of natural and technical system, environment and electromagnetic probing monitoring system are analysed. External natural noise factors are revealed and described. Importance of control of the factors revealed is proved.

articleTitle: Modeling and design of planar gyrotron with sheet electron beam
abstract: The results of theoretical study and numerical simulations of planar gyrotrons with sheet helicak electron beam are presented. An advantage of this scheme compared with conventional cylindrical geometry is the possibility to ensure effective mode selection over open transverse coordinate in combination with radiation out-coupling that leads to substantial reduction of Ohmic losses. Similar to unstable resonators in optics for further growth of radiation power it is beneficial to introduce the waveguide tapering.

articleTitle: Radiation effects in VLSI Ferroelectric Random Access nonvolatile Memory
abstract: The results of experimental researches of radiation resistance of VLSI Ferroelectric Random Access nonvolatile Memory (FRAM) at influence of gamma-irradiation Co<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">60</sup> are submitted.

articleTitle: Sample — Tip distance influence in Scanning Microwave Microscopy
abstract: This paper contains a microwave-field distribution dependence of sample-tip distance (STD) along the system probe-distance-sample axis for a finite coaxial resonator probe (CCRP). In addition, the STD dependence of fundamental signals is presented.

articleTitle: Two approches comparison concerning the determination of spectrum in crossed — Field devices
abstract: The possibility of adaptation of the systems describing operation of devices with crossed fields to the linearized ones is considered. This simplification allows significantly simplifying the study of output spectrum in certain processes in crossed-field devices.

articleTitle: Loaded sections using for dual-band parallel-coupled strip-line-resonator bandpass filters design
abstract: The method of bandpass filter based on parallel-coupled strip-line-resonator sections modification for operation in two frequency bands is offered. The adduced analytical correlations enable to calculate the elements electrical parameters of such sections with different structures.

articleTitle: Method of fluorescent probes to monitor the changes in human erythrocyte membranes under the ifluence of magnetic or electromagnetic fields
abstract: The changes in human erythrocyte membrane under the influence of the weak magnetic field and low-level electromagnetic field have been studied by using fluorescent probes (derivatives of 2,5-diaryloxazole and oxadiazole) with a different location in a lipid membrane. It has been found that both the microwave radiation and the magnetic field may cause a decrease in membrane viscosity in the most hydrophobic regions of a lipid bilayer and in the center of bilayer and/or, more probably, may cause the an increase in hydration of the most polar surface regions of the membrane, while minor changes are observed in the area of carbonyl groups of phos-pholipids and adjacent methylene chains of phospholipids.

articleTitle: Influence of phase fluctuation on the probability characteristics of QAM-signal
abstract: The influence of phase fluctuations of signal with QAM-16 in the receiver of radio telecommunication systems is considered. The effect of the fluctuated phase's rate on the probability characteristics of the received signal is calculated.

articleTitle: Parameter optimization in outer and inner codes of concatenated code
abstract: The problems of word length optimal correction choice of outer and inner codes in a concatenated code that provides (code combination maximal length and minimal code rate) the minimal probability equivalent bit mistake are considered.

articleTitle: Continual simulation of electromagnetic excitation of resonant vibration of carbon nanotube arrays
abstract: Simulation of the excitation of mechanical vibrations in carbon nanotube arrays by ponderomotive forces is presented in continual approximation on the basis of electrodynamics of moving bodies, elasticity theory and van der Waals interactions' theory.

articleTitle: Model of ohmic contact in mesfet with large particle calculation method
abstract: The paper presents the main points on which a new implementation of the numerical model of an ohmic metal-semiconductor contact was built. As a result of computational experiments the current-voltage characteristics of contact and fields distribution were obtained, indicating the reliability of the model.

articleTitle: Twist-reflectors Based upon micristrip arrays
abstract: Based upon the mathematical model of a microstrip-stud reflectarray, the high-technological broadband twist reflectors made as integral variants have been manufactured and tested.

articleTitle: On the approach to the singularity problem of the material parameters in coordinate transformation
abstract: In the present paper a nonsingular cloak is used as a carpet of invisibility We have shown the possibility to calculate the nonsingular invisibility cloak of arbitrary shape by choosing the elliptical system of coordinates in coordinate transformation. Numerical simulation of invisibility carpets with of arbitrary shapes is performed.

articleTitle: Airborne array antennas with wide angle scanning
abstract: Electrodynamic model for array antennas with wide angle scanning is developed. The directional characteristics of array antennas are presented.

articleTitle: Microwave phase method for liquid level measurement in a tank
abstract: The microwave phase method for a liquid level measurement in a tank is considered. It covers accuracy inherent to phase method and unambiguity of level determination. Sensitivity and accuracy do not depend on a value of measured liquid level. These characteristics result from application of a two-channel structural scheme of the microwave measuring device.

articleTitle: On the potentilities of detecting small-size sea surface objects using a marine radar «Burevisnyk-3»
abstract: The function circuit and performance characteristics of dual band radioelectronic facilities (DBRF) “Burevisnyk-3”, which is a new-generation complex integrated radio electronics system operating in the X-band and Ka-band wavelength with a unitary control system, are described. The above radar system is intended for technical surveillance and monitoring of open water area situation. It is located at coastal observation points in an effort to tackle the navigation issues, to control the equipment operations aboard river and sea-going ships, including high-speed “screenplanes”, hydrofoil vessels and air-cushion vessels.

articleTitle: Re-emission features in nonlinear radar
abstract: The features of density estimation of obstacle nonlinear scatterers (NS), based on "metal-oxide-metal" structures with the system of preliminary nonlinear sounding (SPNS), are considered. The expediency of usage for SPNS as a probing signal of the additive combination of the component of phase-modulated (FM) signal and "white" Gaussian noise is shown. We also show that the presence of features of the probing signal transformation by obstacle NS SPNS allows making density estimation of the present obstacle nonlinear scatterers in the investigated by nonlinear radars space.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic shields on the base of mineral and organic components for the different objects protection in microwave band
abstract: Test samples of electromagnetic radiation (EMR) shields on the base of mineral silicone, carbon sorbent powders with the addition of hydrophilic solutions of metal salts and organic components have been developed. The shieldiing properties of test samples in the frequency range 8 … 12 GHz have been investigated. Comparative analysis of shielding properties of the investigated structures is performed.

articleTitle: Resolution of cavity probes of scanning microwave microscopy
abstract: The results on numerical studies of the dependence of the fundamental signal scanning microwave microscopy upon the radius of tip shape of the cavity probe are described.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic wave transition through a layer of biisotropic composite material
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic wave transition through a plane layer with chiral properties of a composite material, made of resistive fibers in the form of few-coil helices, is solved. The influence of different parameters that characterize the composite on angular and frequency dependencies of amplitude and polarization characteristics of the passing and reflected electromagnetic waves is investigated.

articleTitle: 3-D simulation of 32 GHz cold cathode magnetron operating in the (−1)-st space harmonic of π/2-mode oscillations
abstract: An analytic estimate has been made of the optimal parameters of a pulsed cold secondary-emission cathode magnetron operating at a frequency of 32 GHz with anode voltage of 8 kV and magnetic field of 0.4 T. The magnetron interaction space geometry facilitates the interplay of electrons and the microwave-field of the 1-st space harmonic of π-mode oscillations. The numerical experiment involving the use of a 3-D model has been performed to see whether the magnetrons with analytically specified parameters are capable of operating required energy characteristics. We have provided ample evidence of the opportunity to engineer the type of a magnetron, which can be efficiently operated with relatively lower anode voltages, acceptable magnetic field, energy parameter and maximum lifetime. All these operational features will open new fields of applications in mariner radar transmitters. Specifically, they will be able to address a series of specific problems at surveillance stations and to monitor the movements of small-size above-water objects, navigational aspects of high-speed hydrofoil vessels, ground-effect crafts. In addition, all the above features will beneficial in terms of piloting all kinds of vessels in the open waters close to the ports' coastal areas where the navigation traffic is heavy.

articleTitle: Metal-dielectric plate waveguide filter
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental studies into metal-dielectric plate waveguide filter is described.

articleTitle: Optimization of chip-element filter circuit design
abstract: The problem of designing stock-produced EHF-and UHF bandpass filters is considered. Frequency dependences of the parameters of used elements and circuit boards as well as spurious wiring parameters are described. The selection of the filter design circuit is motivated. Typical amplitude-frequency characteristics and their dependence upon the percentage scatter of nominal values of used elements are presented.

articleTitle: Skin effect of biotechnical objects at diagnostic and medical equipment
abstract: The model of skin-effect in an object's surface layer is considered for a case of diagnostics and medical treatment as a result of interactions of electromagnetic fields of bio-technical objects.

articleTitle: A K- to Ka-band monolithic doubly-balanced mixer based on vertical Schottky diodes
abstract: Presented in this paper are results of development of monolithic broadband doubly-balanced mixers based on vertical Schottky diodes.

articleTitle: RT-22 CRAO: The testing of the Ground-based segment of the Radioastron mission
abstract: As a part of the scientific cooperation between Ukraine and Russia, a series of studies on the preparation of the ground segment of the RadioAstron mission has been carried out. A scientific program of measurements to be performed using the 22-m RT-22 radio telescope (Crimean Astrophysical Observatory) has been prepared. A substantial part of this program is the study of compact structures in extragalactic sources. Ground-based VLBI test experiments at 1.35 cm, 6 and 18 cm intended for testing a model of the ground segments of the RadioAstron mission have been carried out at RT-22 of the Crimean Astrophysical Observatory in Simeiz, RT-22 in Pushchino and RT-70 in Evpatoria. The processing of the data recorded by each antenna resulted in obtaining and calibrating responses of cross-correlation functions using the ASC LPI correlator. The results of the experiment demonstrate the readiness of RT-22 to participate in the ground-space radio interferometer sessions in the RadioAstron mission.

articleTitle: Optimization of spin-torque microwave detector
abstract: We propose an engineering model for determination of minimum detectable microwave power (MDMP) of a spin-torque microwave detector (STMD) connected to a standard 50-Ohm load. We obtain that the MDMP of a STMD can reach 10 nW at room temperature. The developed formalism can be used for the optimization of the practical parameters of various systems based on a STMD.

articleTitle: RF-microswitch on the basis of aluminum MEMS technology
abstract: The RF MEMS microswitch technology on the basis of aluminum and anodic aluminum oxide as the working and sacrificial layers, respectively are considered. It is shown that the use of local anodization of aluminum eliminates the need for additional procedures of sacrificial layers formation. Due to the lack of high-temperature operation the proposed technology allows creating the micromechanical systems on a single chip with the control electronics.

articleTitle: Binary data transfer on the base of delayed pulse M-sequences interference
abstract: The method for secure transfer of the binary data is considered on the basis of spectral interference of the delayed pulse M-sequences. The processing in the receiver uses a double spectral analysis for restoration of cross correlation function. Data bits are coded with the help of two various delays. For the given method the estimation of a level of the side lobes of cross correlation function, carried out in the report, is a matter of principle.

articleTitle: Space-charge waves in InN-InBN-InN Gunn diodes
abstract: We have used a numerical method for analyzing the space-change wave in a graded-gap InBN diodes. We have obtained the output characteristics of graded-gap InBN Gunn diodes with different BN contents binary components in a diode is found. The graded-gap InBN Gunn diodes are shown to offer greater efficiency in oscillation and output power as againet the InN and graded-gap AlInN diodes.

articleTitle: Determination of permittivity using radio holograms formed by multifrequency fractal antenna
abstract: We have studied the possibility of a reference method for determination of the permittivity of the substance by radio holograms using a fractal irradiator. The method is simulated on four operating frequencies of the radiating fractal antenna in the electrodynamic modeling system FEKO. The optimal working frequency, which provides the best accuracy for the method, is determined.

articleTitle: Optimization of irregular antenna arrays taking into account mutual coupling of radiators
abstract: Application of the modified point objective function taking into account mutual interference of radiators for optimization of the level of the side lobes of the directional pattern of antenna arrays has been considered. The procedure of optimization has been applied to the irregular antenna array out of the sub-arrays with a different period. The comparison of the results of optimization with the results of modeling of this antenna array by the method of moments has been made.

articleTitle: Autodyne microwave generator model for determination of its dynamic features
abstract: The paper presents the results of mathematical model development of a microwave autodyne oscillator in the way of a differential equation system derived for changing oscillation amplitude and frequency, as well as for the response of the oscillator by way of autodetection signal changes. A model, which is required to determine the dynamic features of microwave generators, takes into account their internal parameters such as nonisochronism, nonizodromism, and the frequency detection phenomenon, as well as the conditions of rapid movement of the reflecting object.

articleTitle: Signals preprocessing in the distributed networks at magnetotelluric sounding
abstract: Considered in this paper is selection of geomagnetic field informative signals filtration algorithm in order to reduce the load of distributed network communication channels in magnetotelluric probing system.

articleTitle: Application of metal coverings for radiation protection of silicon p-n-structures
abstract: The results of experimental researches of protective properties of screens on the basis of multilayered metal coverings Bi/Cu and alloys PbSn under electron irradiation with 4 MeV energy of silicon diode n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-p-structures are submitted.

articleTitle: Influence of surface morphology on the instrument characteristics of planar INP/GAAS Schottky diodes in millimeter range
abstract: With the use of AFM it has been demonstrated one of the possible ideal surface states of the epitaxial layer n-InP, which allows obtaining the metal-semiconductor contacts in submillimeter range with a low Schottky barrier height ϕ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf><0.5 eV, the ideality index n <1.07, and series resistance RS <10 ohm. It was shown in practice, that the semiconductor surface required to obtain quality metal-semiconductor contacts with Schottky barrier should be considered not only in terms of minimum linear dimensions of the irregularities and inhomogeneities, but also in terms of ideality of their statistical distribution, which is known to be characterized by a Gaussian function. At the same time, not all ideal states of n-InP surface can be equally suitable for obtaining of quality metal-semiconductor contacts with Schottky barrier.

articleTitle: Impulse ultra wideband signals relaying in self-organizing radio networks
abstract: Methods of IR-UWB signals relaying in ad hoc and MANET networks are considered.

articleTitle: Spatial compensator of active and intermodulation interferences in presence of mutual element coupling in active antenna array
abstract: This paper deals with the problem of intermodulation interferences in the receiving path of an active antenna array. The authors have proposed algorithm of the antenna array spatial structure adaptation which allows increasing active and intermodulation interference immunity.

articleTitle: Monochromatic oscillation generator for novel microwave resonant therapy
abstract: A monochromatic oscillation generator for microwave resonant therapy is proposed. The proposed device allows one to detect two biologically active points (BAP) on a human body, at which the electromagnetic radiation index is maximum. This device helps to determine the level and frequency of millimeter-wave (MW) range radiation in the process of a treatment procedure. The device is capable of controlling an inter-pulse interval that is coincident with a rate of patients' bio-rhythms. In this case the frequency and modulation signal pauses are controlled. As a result, the treatment efficiency tends to increase and the periods of treatment procedures are reduced.

articleTitle: Microstrip hairpin filter's optimization through changes in the angle between the coupledline sections
abstract: A method for optimizing a microstrip hairpin bandpass filter by changing the angle between the coupled-line sections in order to reduce the insertion and return losses is proposed in the HFSS. The method is based on building filter's sections in different relative coordinate systems whose parameters depend on the value of the angle between the coupled-line sections.

articleTitle: Evolution of methods for meteor phenomena investigations using digital TV broadcasting signals
abstract: Aspects of the digital TV broadcasting signals using (standard DVB-T2) for meteor phenomena investigations are considered. Found that the digital TV signal contains continuous pilot signals predefined parameters. This fact allows generating a reference signal, and determining the reflected from meteor trail signal properties by comparison with the reference one.

articleTitle: “Contact-11M.34M1 IPTV” digital modem for analog radio-relay station
abstract: It is considered the digital modem [1] manufactured by Beta TVcom Ltd. with the help of which it is possible to transmit IPTV, ASI and Ethernet digital streams at 34 Mbps using a radiopath of analog RRS (ARRS) type Kurs 6, Kurs 8, Helios 834, P600-2MB and other operating with FM signals.

articleTitle: Threshold effects at phase measurements temporal provision of signals
abstract: The model of an assessment of a phase by a temporal method after time strobbing of signals on an exit of the matched filter and the model of quadrature signal processing are developed. When modeling the main attention paid to threshold effects.

articleTitle: The features of temperature dependence pc(T) in ohmic contacts to n-GaN (n-AlN) with high dislocation density
abstract: We studied temperature dependences of resistivity ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>(T) of Pd-Ti-Pd-Au ohmic contacts to wide-gap semiconductors n-GaN and n-AlN with high dislocation density. The obtained dependences cannot be explained by the existing mechanisms of current flow. We propose possible mechanisms explaining the experimental ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub>(T) curves for ohmic contacts to n-GaN and n-Al N.

articleTitle: Ground-calibration complex for space-based SAR
abstract: The ground-calibration complex for land-based assessment of the space-based SAR characteristics is designed and developed. Flight tests of the complex are successfully conducted.

articleTitle: Influence of temperature on characteristics of resonant spin-torque microwave nano-detectors
abstract: The theoretical analysis of influence of temperature on the resonant sensitivity and signal-to-noise ratio of a resonance-type spin-torque microwave detector (STMD) has been carried out. We reveal that the resonant sensitivity does not always improve with the decrease of temperature. The developed formalism can be used for the optimization of the practical parameters of a STMD in a wide range of temperatures.

articleTitle: Oscillation efficiency and frequency properties of intervalley-electron transfer GaN diodes
abstract: The results obtained from simulating GaN-based intervalley-electron transfer diodes having different types of cathode contacts (ohmic, metallic, with a lower-concentration region). The main-particle Monte Carlo method was used to analyze electron processes occurring in a diode. The diode parameters and an operating frequency were selected from the condition for obtaining a maximum oscillation frequency. The maximum oscillation frequency for all type of considered diodes is shown to be as high as 600 GHz.

articleTitle: Unified system for microwave generator short-range radar
abstract: The microwave generator, which consists of an exciter and a resonator chamber with Gunn diode 3A750G or 3A762G installed in it, is described. Circuit solution of the stabilization system of the excitation voltage of the Gunn diode has allowed minimizing the influence of a change of destabilizing factors on the characteristics of the generator.

articleTitle: FMR frequency spectra in single crystal BaFe12O19 under the in-plane bias
abstract: Experimental investigations of FMR frequency-field dependencies of a single crystal barium hexaferrite (BaM) platelet in the case of in-plane bias field H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub>, i.e. H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> is oriented perpendicular to the easy axis (EA) both in the multi-domain and saturated state, are carried out. In the domain area the case of cylindrical magnetic domains (CMD) structure is studied. The comparison of experimental results and theoretical calculations were carried out.

articleTitle: Method of ohmic contact characterization from heat stability and contact resistance by example of contacts to SiC 6H
abstract: Using contacts to silicon carbide as an example, a method of ohmic contact characterization from heat stability and contact resistance is proposed. The method is based on the known empirical dependences of (i) contact resistivity on the semiconductor doping level and (ii) ohmic contact degradation on time and temperature.

articleTitle: Evaluation of interference signal from the space allocated abonent stations
abstract: In this paper we determined a correction coefficient that allows presenting the aggregate emission of subscriber stations located in the service area of one base station, as a point source of emission. It significantly reduces the analysis time of electromagnetic compatibility between abonent stations and the means of the radiolocation service.

articleTitle: Directional radiation using in distributed antenna systems for communication spectral efficiency increasing
abstract: In this paper we consider the contribution of the using of directional antennas with angular, and full spatial (3 dimensional) selectivity in a remote radio unit (RRU) of a distributed antenna system (DAS) and the directional radiation at DAS in a sparse array with longitudinal radiation mode with the application of spatio-temporal matched filtration (STMF) on the wireless communication spectral efficiency.

articleTitle: Limitation simulation of microwave filter based on experimental data
abstract: Microwave filters characteristics are distorted in real-system tracts. These distortions can not be predicted with help of measuring instrumentation, but it is possible to predict them by imitating simulation methods. The results from the analysis of filters characteristics distortions based on these methods are presented.

articleTitle: Recording technique of photoplethysmographic signals for study in the phase plane
abstract: The recording technique of photoplethysmographic signals for their study in the phase plane and determination of the functional state of CVS by means of computation of R-S indices, is presented.

articleTitle: Features of transceiver unit of external design for operating in 6–13 GHz range
abstract: The present paper concerns the universal small case for transceivers from the composition of radio-relay stations, for transmitters from the composition of wireless systems of digital TV transmission and for multimedia systems of data transmission.

articleTitle: Filter for phase-shift keyed signal compression in the presence of Doppler frequency shift
abstract: The mismatched sidelobe-free filter is proposed for phase-shift keyed signal compression in the presence of Doppler frequency shift. Analysis of effectiveness of phase-shift keyed signal compression using the proposed filter is carried out for different values of Doppler frequency.

articleTitle: A methodology for authoring information aggregation and retrieval workflows in scalable infrastructures
abstract: With the increasing popularity of stream-based information sources on the Web, a seemingly continuous and endless flow of messages is generated and propagated to the users. This makes it important to provide systems for reducing the information load on users by employing filtering and ranking techniques. Constructing such systems is an important task in the research domain of Internet Information Retrieval (IIR). In this paper we are presenting a novel approach for creating processing workflows for information aggregation and retrieval tasks. It is backed by a system architecture called Spectre, which allows the realization of distributed and highly scalable systems. A graphical authoring tool named Spectre Cockpit allows defining, configuring and deploying IIR systems providing an all-embracing methodology for the IIR authoring process.

articleTitle: The multifrequency mode of oscillator stabilized by two resonators
abstract: Possibility of excitation of the two-frequency mode of oscillations during stabilization of a Gunn oscillator by two resonators is shown. The frequency spacing and, also, influence of voltage supplied to the Gunn diode on frequency characteristics of resonators are investigated.

articleTitle: Characteristics of GaN nanotube MOS field-effect transistor
abstract: MOS device model is designed as a semiconductor channel in which gallium nitride nanotube (GaNNT) with indices (9,0) is used. Numerical parameters of the model are as follows: channel length - 22 nm; thickness of gate insulator HfO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> - 5 nm; channel width (was considered as a circumference of the nanotube) - 2.89 nm; effective mass of electron 0.25·9.1·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-31</sup> kg; bandgap energy - 2.16 eV. Input and output characteristics of the transistor; threshold voltage 1.03 V; trans-conductance 2.25·10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> A/V; electronic mobility 34 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/(V·s) have been calculated. For calculations both step-by-step DOS and self-consistent potential of the nanotube have been used.

articleTitle: Cobalt nanoparticle arrays for memory applications
abstract: The technique for obtaining of ordered magnetic cobalt nanoparticle arrays on mono-crystal Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> substrates is considered. The results of microscopic studies show a uniform distribution of nanoparticles on the substrate. Study of the magneto-optical properties shows the possibility of using such structures in memory applications, biosensors, sensors of magnetic field and position.

articleTitle: Measurement of basic Q-factor of electronic beam exciting superconducting cavity
abstract: A precise method for measuring of ultra-high basic Q-factors of the superconducting cavities is proposed. It is, based upon the electronic beam-excited oscillations. In this measurement the cavity is not coupled to any external microwave circuits. Its basic Q-factor is governed by the electron flow power loss, which can be determined to high accuracy.

articleTitle: Function of mutual influence of space-based APhAA radiators
abstract: The present paper deals with some aspects of developing a broadband transmitting space-based APhAA with low-mass and high-power characteristics. Specifically, a method of reducing the number of the APhAA radiators, is discussed without compromising the side lobes level and the directivity fall with suppression of side main pattern maxima. Besides, the issues of mutual influence of radiators as constituents of the APhAA system is likewise considered.

articleTitle: Microwave oscillator characteristics in case of modulation through supply circuit
abstract: The results of analysis of microwave oscillator modulation characteristics, which are modulated through the power supply chain of the active element, are presented. Expressions and plotted graphs of modulation rate frequency response depending on the change of microwave generator amplitude, frequency, and auto-detection signal, are derived. Their behavior peculiarities depending on the modulation frequency are introduced on the basis of the results of numerical calculations of the characteristics.

articleTitle: Multimode excitation of waveguide-slot leaky-wave radiator
abstract: The electrodynamic characteristics of electrically long slot radiators in the narrow wall of a multimode rectangular waveguide have been investigated by the Galerkin's method. The multi-frequency radiator, based on this structure, has been realized at excitation of the waveguide by several modes.

articleTitle: Autodyne mode experimental research of the transceiver of radiosonde MRZ-3MK
abstract: The description of the functional block diagram and the operating principle of the transceiver of radiosonde MRZ-3MK operating in the autodyne mode is introduced. The results of experimental research of the autodyne oscillator operation of this radiosonde in the mode of receiving uplink radar request signal.

articleTitle: The human brain as an object of nanoelectronics
abstract: The interpretation of the human brain as an organic hybrid object of nanoelectronics is presented. The interpretation and its consequences are used for more accurate understanding of main functions of the brain. Complex multilevel approach to simulation of these functions is developed.

articleTitle: Electrophysical properties of metallic wire photonic crystalls
abstract: The simplest wire metallic photonic crystals have been investigated using the electromagnetic simulations based on the periodic Green's function and integral equation approach. The permittivity and permeability tensors have been obtained and explored by using the homogenization for the solutions which correspond to lowest dispersion branches.

articleTitle: Structure and properties of Al2O3 coatings obtained under different deposition conditions
abstract: Using X-ray diffraction methods (XRD), scanning electron microscopy, with microanalysis (SEM with EDS) and positron annihilation spectroscopy (PAS) the Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>, coatings obtained by microarc oxidation under different of deposition conditions were analyzed. It was shown by changing the electrolytic-plasma deposition parameters we can control the element composition of coatings, as well as physical and mechanical properties of coatings and surface morphology.

articleTitle: Telecommunications system for gas monitoring and forecasting of industry and community facilities
abstract: Described in this paper is the development of automated telecommunications system for gas control that can be applied in industrial and municipal facilities. Combined algorithm for predicting concentration values based on artificial neural networks and wavelet transformation, is proposed.

articleTitle: Cone-shaped resonator the high-order mode oscillation trasducers
abstract: The possibilities of using the conic coaxial resonant structures excited in high-Q oscillation modes, for developing resonant measuring transducers for a scanning microwave microscope are analyzed.

articleTitle: Application of non-stationary THz gas spectroscopy method in endocrinology
abstract: The results of application of gas spectroscopy method based on nonstationary effects (free dumping polarization) for medical diagnostics based on analysis of exhaled breath is considered in this work. Investigations of exhaled breath of conditionally healthy volunteers and diabetes patients were carried out with using the nonstationary gas spectrometer of THz frequency range for the detection of the diabetes markers such as acetone, methanol and ethanol.

articleTitle: LPI KA-band radar sensor
abstract: Examples of such devices include navigational X-band radar "BR-24" by Lowrance and River radar from Mi-cran. By maximizing experience of the navigational radar River creation, its developers (authors of the paper) realize a model of millimeter-wave homodyne radar sensor with operation frequency of 33.8 GHz, radiated power 40 mW, LFM-CW sounding signal, beam width in the elevation plane 30 deg. and 1 deg. in the azimuth plane, horizontal size of the antenna aperture of 60 cm, velocity of at azimuth 144 grad/sec, maximum resolution at range ~ 0.5 m, radiated signal bandwidth 50-600 MHz, adjusted at the program level.

articleTitle: Algorithm of bio-radar system simulation model at allocation of respiratory and heartbeat components
abstract: The algorithm of selection of respiration and heartbeat components from biometric signal is developed. Function of some component elements of the bio-radar system simulation model is considered.

articleTitle: Iimprovment of accuracy in measuring non-thermal intensity microwave radiations
abstract: The function circuit of a device for measuring microwave radiations of non-thermal intensity is proposed. Its principle operation is based on the dependence of water resistance following the deep cleaning on intensity of electromagnetic radiations.

articleTitle: Statistical model of nongaussian reflections from the Earth surface at grazing angles
abstract: With use of imbedded semi-Markov processes the statistical model of the signal reflected from the Earth's surface is proposed and on the basis of experimental data determined its constituent parameters.

articleTitle: Optimization of the non-linear inertional multiplier of two random signals of radiometer with noise heterodyne
abstract: The theory of random signal transmission through the non-linear inertial circuit was developed. Based on this theory the optimization of a non-linear multiplier was carried out, the optimal delay of the random signal reflected from a matching stab was determined. The optimized multiplier circuit allows increasing the signal-to-noise ratio increase for 10 dB.

articleTitle: GaAs FET with a sub-surface delta-doped channel
abstract: GaAs FET with a single sub-surface delta-doped channel is realized. The source and the drain have a tunnel ohmic contact to the channel with rather low contact resistance <;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-4</sup> ohm cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. A gate leakage current does not exceed 1 μA in the bias range -1.5...+0.5 V. Due to the extremely thin active region of FET, their current is very sensitive to condition of GaAs surface.

articleTitle: Ferromagnetic resonance in arrays of anisotropic magnetic nanoparticles on hexagonal lattice
abstract: We consider the effects of magnetostatic interaction and ferromagnetic resonance in a frustrated system of anisotropic ferromagnetic nanoparticles packed in a two-dimensional lattice with hexagonal symmetry (artificial spin ice). It is demonstrated, that in an array of interacting particles there are two stable states with a quasi-homogeneous magnetic moments configuration and with a zero magnetic moment. It is shown that the spectrum of ferromagnetic resonance in such system strongly depends on the degree of interaction and the spatial configuration of the magnetic moments.

articleTitle: Matching of dielectric vacuum windows
abstract: We investigate the problem of a broadband matching of a dielectric window with a waveguide duct by an inductive diaphragm or a step. The experiment has detected abnormal slight wave reflections in a matching band. The improvement of the theoretical model has revealed the physical factors, responsible for this phenomenon.

articleTitle: Anomalous rejection in the slot resonators on the higher-mode oscillations
abstract: The efficiency of exciting the slotted cavities of a diffraction grating microwave oscillators is determined as function of depth L and slot width πθ. The anomalous behavior of antiresonant minima of excitation for a π-mode oscillations to the point of their intersection with resonant maxima and their suppression is revealed. When electron slow is in synchronism higher order space harmonics of the field the anomalous rejection occurs at several values of θ. The deviation from the non-optimal values of θ made it possible to ensure that a wavelength λ of generated oscillations was shortened by a factor of 15 (against the known values) due to use of Wood's anomaly regime.

articleTitle: Double diode stabilized autodyne use in radar sensors for the hump yards
abstract: The design and operating principle of a radar device made on the basis of a double diode autodyne oscillator stabilized by an additional high-Q resonator are described. The results of a radar prototype field tests at the hump yard are presented.

articleTitle: Horn antenna acs reducing for wide viewing angle sector
abstract: The design of the pyramidal horn antenna of wide viewing angle sector with the lowered level of wicking currents and reduced radiation from its internal surface is offered.

articleTitle: The International Conference CriMiCo in scientometric databases
abstract: The report presents results of analysis of the bibliometric information set of scientific publications on the International Conference "CriMiCo" over the last decade as a result of information retrieval at international reference databases that generated by scientific societies IEEEXplore ™ - IEEE (USA), INSPEC ™ - IET (UK), and Scopus ™ by Elsevier. As a result, representation level of scientific publication estimates for the global scientific community, the most active groups of scientists and research organizations were defined, the level of international cooperation between research organizations in the Ukraine, CIS and foreign countries was defined at the CriMiCo conference.

articleTitle: Experimental research of resource blocks distribution between user's terminals under interference influence on LTE base station receiver
abstract: The results of experimental researches of process of Up-Link channel resource blocks are used in the networks of wireless broadband access constructed on the basis of LTE technology for the case of the interference lesion of a base station receiver by a signal from radio-electronic means of radar-tracking service of a range 2500-2700MHz.

articleTitle: The scattering of electromagnetic pulses on the lattices of Dielectric Resonators in the open space
abstract: Microwave pulses scattering by various rectangular lattices in the open space is considered. Capabilities of such lattices using for spatio-temporal pulses control are examined.

articleTitle: Wireless access to the future of mobile communication
abstract: A set of utility models has been devised, which offers a new architecture of a mobile communication network and a base station operating in the millimeter wavelength range. The data extracted from these models can be used to develop a multiservice NGN network so as to afford a mobile access to high-speed transport vehicles, i.e. to the interactive heterogeneous telecommunication network (IHTN).

articleTitle: The multifunctional IR-system of ensuring the thermo-neutral environment for the newly-born and infant children
abstract: A set of the optical and electric equipment has been designed to ensure maintenance of the comfortable conditions for performance of the medical treatment procedures for the newly-born and nfant children. It was demonstrated, that while creating the thermal neutral environment owing to the even IR-heating with the power of 75–100 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, it is possible to compensate in the full scope both the heat losses of the human body by the IR-irradiation and other types of the heat losses by means of convection and evaporation processes.

articleTitle: Chernoff bound utilization for radioholographic objects parameters' estimation accuracy by means of minimum-phase method
abstract: The research considers radioholographic object parameters estimation accuracy by means of minimum-phase methods. Its dependence on the input signal-to-noise ratio, sample size and estimated parameters' true value is obtained and analyzed. An approach based on Chernoff bound utilization is applied to the problem of minimum-phase method accuracy estimation, by reducing it into a hypothesis testing problem.

articleTitle: Of solar atmosphere by parameters obtained by radio observations of eclipse on January, 4, 2011 in the Crimea
abstract: Local radio sources had sizes from 1,9 to 2,4 ang. min and had brightness from 80 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> o 1,75 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> K. During 2 years of new 24th cycle of solar activity the radius in the wavelength 10,7 and 12 cm had increased from 1,016R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sub> to 1,05 ± 0,003 R<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">⊙</sub>, the height of emissive layer had moved from 1110<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> km to (30 ± 7)10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> km, the brightness temperature of quiet Sun grew from (35,8 ±0,4) 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> K to (44±3)10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> K. Absence of local sources in the 95 cm wavelength is considered as a sign of low flare activity.

articleTitle: Operation support system of telecoms operator
abstract: It was analyzed the modern system of business management - the processes of operator NGOSS (New Generation Operations Systems and Software), which helps to create a cross-cutting structure design, integration and operation of OSS / BSS. The key elements of the system such as: eTom, SID, TNA, TAM, SANRR, were reviewed and analyzed.

articleTitle: Development and testing research method of electromagnetic radiation power influence on protective shields characteristics
abstract: A method for measurement of electromagnetic radiation power of a microwave frequencies range passing through the material was developed. The testing of the developed technique on constructions of protective shields made from finely divided metal containing and carbon containing powders was performed. The calculation error of the measurements was made.

articleTitle: Method for calculating the required performance of MPLS network branches
abstract: A mathematical tool for evaluating the required performance of tunneled MPLS network branches is considered. This procedure allows for the effect of multi path dynamic routing and simultaneous servicing of message flows from different communication directions in one and same branches.

articleTitle: Experimental setup for the study into the parameters of homodyne measuring transducers
abstract: The present communication is devoted to analyzing the parameters of a computer-aided setup intended to examine the characteristics of homodyne transducers are presented. The characteristics of homodyne transducer, which was analyzed by means of the above setup, are presented.

articleTitle: The problem associated with signal processing in the implementation of incoherent radar methods
abstract: The problems of enhancing the coherence properties of radar signals are examined in incoherent pulsed radar facilities.

articleTitle: Accuracy enhancement of the AIMS by passive locations by means of robust methods
abstract: An algorithm for the construction of the air flying objects routes was created with using the robust method. Mathematical tools of the method were presented there, practical results based on a study of the real signal of the radio source (IRI) were also shown. A comparison of existing methods for the determination of the objectives' range was made; their advantages and disadvantages were noticed. It is proved that using of the robust method gives adequate results in the determination of the IRI range, formulated recommendations regarding the further application of the robust method.

articleTitle: The transverse resonance technique for analysis of O-shaped slot resonators with mutual coupling in microstrip line earthing layer
abstract: The scattering matrix calculation algorithm of three mutually coupled O-shaped slot resonators in microstrip line earthing layer was composed using transverse resonance technique. In the modified algorithm the “electrical” and “magnetic” boundary problems are solved for the structure as a whole while taking into account the longitudinal harmonics of current density in microstrip line and high-order modes of the O-shaped waveguide which describes the field in the slot resonator's aperture. It admits the high-precision calculation of the structure's scattering matrix elements with mutual influence of the slot resonators taken into account.

articleTitle: Design of dispersion in slow wave systems like combs and meander for high frequency TWT
abstract: Two different electrodynamical methods of dispersion analysis have been applied for slow wave systems like combs and meander.

articleTitle: The radial klinoorotron simulation
abstract: Simulation of the millimeter and submillimeter wavelengths generator - klinoorotron with inclinated radial electronic beam is carried out. In this device the plane radial electron beam shaped in a ring electronic gun, is put under a small corner at the slowing waves system designed as a radial comb on a mirror of the open resonator. The carried out calculations validate high efficiency of the suggested construction radial klinoorotron.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable antenna design algorithm
abstract: The general RF device design algorithm is examined, on the basis of which a reconfigurable antenna (RA) design algorithm is developed. A mathematical model of near-omnidirectional thin-wire reconfigurable antennas is presented based on the integral equation method. The validity of the model for reconfigurable structures containing both analog driven elements and discrete switching elements is shown.

articleTitle: Quasioptical reflectometer of internal reflection for carbon plastics surface evaluation
abstract: Quasi-optical (QO) reflectometer of internal reflection (IR) on the basis of a hollow dielectric beamguide (HDB) and a number of beamguiding components and devices of THz frequency range is developed. The reflectometer is tested for detection of surface contaminations and sub-surface damages of carbon fiber reinforced plastic (CFRP). The results of the study of CFRP samples with different contaminations in sub-THz frequency range (0.1...0.2) THz are shown.

articleTitle: Determination of the radiation field for multi-band antennas
abstract: This paper introduces a method of determining the geometry of the multiband antenna, and developed an algorithm for determining the currents on its surface. The possibility of further calculation of the radiation field is demonstrated.

articleTitle: On some historical aspects in the development of cable television in Sevastopol: "Balaklaviya" TRC
abstract: We have made an attempt to give a brief outline of some important milestones in the evolution of local cable television in Sevastopol. We present one of the pages describing the eventful span of time between 1990 and 2000.

articleTitle: Self-organization of copper nanoparticles on KCl (001) at quasi-equilibrium condensation
abstract: Structure formation mechanisms and self-organization of Cu nanoparticles have been studied experimentally at quasi-equilibrium condensation of sputtered substance in high-pure inert medium. A mathematical model of mass transfer near a substrate at increased working gas pressure has shown decrease in supersaturation, resulting in averaging of nanocrystal sizes by means of Ostwald ripening.

articleTitle: Formation of fractal nikel condensates in ultrapure inert medium
abstract: It has been established that nickel condensates in the form of low-dimensional porous systems can be obtained at quasi-equilibrium steady state condensation. It has been shown that porosity formation occurs without coalescence upon reorientation of the condensed flux in the region of the initial cluster aggregation and also when homonucleation of new clusters takes place in the regions of the initial cluster intergrowth.

articleTitle: Potentialities of determining location using electromagnetic wave phase front in the global radionavigation systems
abstract: The potentialities of determining the navigation object locations using the radio signal phase data in the global navigation systems are investigated. Mathematical expressions for the root mean square (RMS) of the measurement are found. Calculation results are presented.

articleTitle: MIMO system based on space-time matched filtering
abstract: The basic principles of designing and operation of MIMO systems based on space-time matched filtering (STMF) are considered. The advantages of MIMO-STMF systems over the MIMO systems with space-time coding (STC) is substantiated by comparing their spectral efficiency with the quality of the wireless transmission channel.

articleTitle: Uncooled hybrid receivers of direct detection of the MM-range on the basis of hot electrons bolometers based and Schottky diodes
abstract: Uncooled narrow-gap mercury-cadmium-telluride (MCT) semiconductor thin layers grown on GaAs substrates hybridized with antennas on low permittivity dielectric substrates were considered as 128-144 GHz direct detection 6-element bolometers. Noise equivalent power (NEP) of such detectors in the observed frequency range v ≈ 128-144 GHz reaches NEP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">300K</sub> ≈ 2.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-10</sup> W/Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sup> (with calculated gain G ≈ 9 dBi). To compare the results obtained the measurements of GaAs conventional Schottky barrier diode (SBD) detectors were fulfilled in the same conditions for which the comparable to MCT bolometers NEP was obtained.

articleTitle: Space power combining in the active antenna array
abstract: Mutual and external synchronization of the oscillations in the linear array of log-periodic antennas on the dielectric substrate with field-effect transistors as active elements is studied. The opportunity of effective special power combining is experimentally shown.

articleTitle: Magnetoelectric microwave power sensor
abstract: Microwave power sensor based on the toroidal cavity with a magnetoelectric element was designed. Sensor sensitivity was of 0.1 mV/W, which allows measuring the high levels of microwave power.

articleTitle: The use of discrete-time algebra apparatus in the description of optical switch operational mechanisms
abstract: The present paper discusses the Qos mechanisms of the optical network with pulse burst transfer by illustrating the way of organizing the operation of an optical switch. It is shown that it makes sense to describe these processes in terms of idempotent algebra. A mathematical model is presented.

articleTitle: Pulse oscillator with electronic frequency switching in millimeter frequency range
abstract: The results of development of pulse mode oscillators with electronic frequency switching from pulse to pulse are given. Small-sized frequency synthesizer of 8 mm wavelengths forming pulses of specified duration with amplitude 1-1.2 W is used as a high stable driving oscillator of microwave pulse. Synchronized amplifier made on IMPATT diodes provides power up to 20 W in oscillator output with microwave pulse duration of impulses of 100-300 nanoseconds in an operating band ~10%. The matching of high-frequency loadings and IMPATT structure is reached by installing a diode in a parallel resonance circuit which parameters are determined by selection of the geometrical sizes of dielectric bushing and type of mounting. Thus, the additional inhomogeneity in a waveguide channel is excluded. The reserved power is concentrated basically in the packaged diode field. For expansion of an amplifier-operating band consistently with a parallel resonance diode circuit, it is expedient to include a consecutive resonance circuit that essentially reduces diode susceptance and increases a synchronization band in the frequency range. The developed oscillator can be used as a driving source for synchronization of semiconductor and electro vacuum powerful devices of the pulse mode.

articleTitle: Inverse V-vibrators for communication of SoC with macrolevel
abstract: In the report for the realization of connection of SoC with a macrolevel it is proposed to use the inverse V-vibrators as wire antennas located along the edges of pyramidal nanocircuits on a tangent to them or with rounding of zigzag relief of a multilevel nanopyramid.

articleTitle: The increase of output microwave power of a vircator by means of external weak single-frequency signal influence
abstract: We have provided an analytical, numerical and experimental investigation of the output power of a virtual cathode oscillator under the external harmonic weak signal influence. We have shown both theoretically and experimentally that increasing the external action leads to output power growth of a non-autonomous vircator (see Fig. 1). The results of theoretical analysis are in a good agreement with the results of the experimental study. We have also analyzed physical processes in the electron beam with virtual cathode by means of consideration of spacetime diagrams of the electron beam in the vircator interaction space and the charge density distributions along the length of the vircator. It has been shown that increase of output power of the vircator is connected with increasing the bunched current in a virtual cathode region. Such conclusion has been confirmed by analysis of a steady-state model of the interaction of a pre-modulated electron beam with the electric braking field of the virtual cathode.

articleTitle: Slot radiator in the semi-infinite coaxial line
abstract: The problem of transverse slot excitation, cut in the outer conductor of the semi-infinite coaxial line was solved with the magnetomotive forces method. The energy characteristics of the radiator from slot and feeder parameters were studied in the broad band of wavelengths.

articleTitle: Intercomparison of numerical methods of modelling of radiowave scattering on finite cylinder objects
abstract: The comparison of certain methods to solving of millimeter wave scattering of the finite length cylinders was carried out.

articleTitle: The contribution of the Kharkov Institute of Radioelectronics to training of scientific, industrial engineering personnel of radioelectronic specialization (over the period 1960–1980)
abstract: This paper describes the establishment and activity of Kharkiv Institute of Radiolectronics. Based upon the research work carried out at this Institute the role of the KhIRE in the development of radioelectronics in Ukraine over the period 1960–1980 is shown.

articleTitle: Head and leader of Antenna Research school (to the 85th anniversary of Professor Voskresensky D. I.)
abstract: On 17 October 2011 full 85 years passed since the day of birth of the Professor, Doctor of Science Voskresensky Dmitry Ivanovich, laureate of State USSR prize and of USSR Council of Ministers prize, the laureate of three prizes of USSR Ministry of High education, honored worker of science and honored worker of Soviet High school. The scientific community recognizes D. I. Voskresensky as a distinguished scientist, who made significant contribution to the development of world and national science in the field of antennas and microwave theory and techniques. Professor D. I. Voskresensky is the author of many scientific publications and monographs, promoting the efficient approaches in theory and design of antennas and microwave techniques. He generated a number of scientific studies in the above mentioned field, being widely developed further by his advanced learners. Professor D. I. Voskresensky developed the theory of waveguide systems (1955–1960), proposed a new class of convex scanning antennas (1963–1978), developed the theory of antenna systems with signal processing, published fundamental papers in theory of phased arrays. During his scientific activities D. I. Voskresensky published more than 200 publications (including 32 patents, 20 monographs). Professor D. I. Voskresensky is also a talented mentor of young people. He is a founder and head of recognized Antenna school MAI, which is supported by the Russian Foundation of Basic Research Russian Academy of Science (RFBR RAN), editorial board member of number of Russian scientific magazines. During many years he was a Program Committee member of scientific conferences, symposia and workshops (since 1999 he is full member of Program Committee CriMiCo). Professor D. I. Voskresensky is the member of Council on education (Chairman of the Commission on radio electronic warfare), full member of International Academy of Science on Information Processes and Technology (1994), honorary Academician in Academy of Applied Radio Electronics of Belarus, Russia and Ukraine (1999). He is awarded medals by the name of Wiener, A. S. Lavochkin and others. Organizing Committee of conference CriMiCo»2007 unanimously decided to assign the name of Professor D. I. Voskresensky for the minor planet.

articleTitle: Role of interdependence dissipative and conservative self-organization in obtaining low-dimensional 3D-systems
abstract: The physical basics and construction of the accumulative plasma-condensate systems (APCS), in which there is a dissipative self-organization of critically low steady-state supersaturation, have been set out. On the example of Ti, Al, Cr, Cu, and C quasi-equilibrium condensation we determined formation mechanisms of low-dimensional 3D-systems. The interdependence of conservative and dissipative self-organizations, as a basis for fabrication of condensates with different architectures, is revealed.

articleTitle: Kinetic analysis of the quasi-equilibrium condensation process
abstract: The phase portraits of the quasi-equilibrium condensation process at different relations of relaxation times of the concentration, the desorption flux and of the growing surface temperature were investigated.

articleTitle: Design of millimeter IMPATT diodes with concentric ring geometry of active structures in pulsed mode
abstract: For the pulse millimeter IMPATT diodes a new configuration of active structures as an array of concentric ring mesa structures is proposed. Numerical evaluation of pulsed thermal spreading resistance IMPATT 8-mm range on the basis of such arrays with the width of the ring 4 μm pulse duration nutrition 100 and 300 ns is carried out. A possibility of a significant reduction in the proposed configuration of the active structure in comparison with the standard one mesa design with an equal area of the p-n junction is studied.

articleTitle: Power microwave voltage oscillations in semiconductor diode at high current density
abstract: Numerical methods were used to investigate the operation of the diffusive silicon p<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-p-n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> diode. The reversed current density of 50 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> passed through the diode having the width of 320 μm, p-n junction depth of 220 μm, and surface area of 0.5 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. It is shown that at a current density of 3÷20 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, in the structure of the diode there is a mode of undamped voltage oscillations. Outside of this range in the structure the mode of stationary breakdown is established. The most powerful oscillations exist at a current density ~15 kA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, with power of oscillations in the diode of ~1 MW, frequency ~10 GHz and efficiency ~30 %.

articleTitle: Investigation of the effectiveness of desktop grid system based on MPICH-2
abstract: The construction of the laboratory multiplatform grid system based on the MPICH-2 is completed. The research performance of a grid-system vs. the number of nodes and bandwidth is studied.

articleTitle: Two-loop synthesizer of spectrum analyzerfrequency
abstract: We consider a number of issues relevant to practical application of the microwave spectrum analyzer, which is made using a digital frequency synthesizer oscillator with a high resolution of (less than 1 Hz) and low phase noise. We developed a frequency synthesizer using a two-loop PLL synthesizer and direct digital synthesis (DDS) on the elemental basis of a high degree of integration, which allowed obtaining the required parameters, and providing multi-functionality and software-tunable operation for all elements and components of the spectrum analyzer.

articleTitle: Comparison of radar and acoustic methods for atmosphere sounding
abstract: Difference between theoretical foundations of creating the methods for information separation at radar and acoustic atmosphere sounding is considered in the report.

articleTitle: The use of polygaussian model for describing seasonal dependences of the tropospheric refractive index
abstract: The possibility of describing the statistics of the refractive index in the troposphere by means of polygaussian models is discussed. The parameters included in the model are derived experimentally. The proposed approach can be used to device a simulation model of the refractive index using the enclosed semi-Markov processes.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of virtual cathode formation in relativistic electron beam with self-magnetic fields
abstract: Virtual cathode (VC) formation processes in tubular relativistic electron beam (REB) in the external magnetic field are analyzed numerically using 3D electromagnetic model. It was discovered that dynamics of VC in the system is determined by the value of external magnetic field and by peculiarities of physical processes in REB.

articleTitle: Study of broadband noise-like microwave generator based on the multispeed nonlaminar electron beams
abstract: The paper presents the results of theoretical and experimental studies of multi-speed turbulent electron beams. Theoretical and experimental studies of the structure of such beams were considered. Various methods of forming a multi-speed electron beams were considered. It is shown that these electron beams generated turbulence, which leads to the emergence of multiple bunches of space charge, which are sources of broadband noise-like oscillations. The results of experimental research of laboratory model of small-sized generator, which is based on the principles of the formation and use of multi-speed turbulent electron beams, were shown.

articleTitle: Influence of physical and topological parameters of inhomogeneous microstrip ring resonator on its frequency characteristics
abstract: An electromechanical tuning method of the inhomogeneous microstrip ring resonator is proposed. The influence of physical and topological characteristics of the ring resonator on its frequency characteristics is discussed. A model of the ring resonator for the calculation of resonant frequencies is presented as a cascade connection of uniform transmission lines.

articleTitle: One- and multilayer absorbing UHF structures based on polymercarbon nanocomposites
abstract: The design principles and electromagnetic properties of single and multi-absorbing coatings based on nanocomposites of carbon are discussed. The properties of these materials were measured by waveguide method in the range of 8-12 GHz (X-Band). Properties of such structures were investigated experimentally and theoretically.

articleTitle: Combining of the experiment and numerical simulation for electron beam optimization of the TWT system
abstract: In the present paper the experimental and numerical methods combining for quality analyzing and determination of the optimal electron beam (EB) characteristics in TWT systems has been proposed. Potentials, which form EB with the best quality, were determined as well by experimental modeling of the operating modes of the electron gun.

articleTitle: Modulation meter of microwave electromagnetic permeability for fabrics
abstract: Principles of constructing the devices for measuring electromagnetic permeability of fabrics in a microwave range are developed. Evaluation of electromagnetic permeability of fabrics is very important, because it provide protection of a person against the environment effects and create a feeling of comfort during the working hours and rest.

articleTitle: Electrostrictive tuneable microwave devices
abstract: Electrostriction can be used to control low loss and highly tunable microwave dielectric devices (filters and phase shifters). Dielectric or metallic parts of such a device should have the dirigible air gap between them. For non-hysteresis control these devices use relaxor ferroelectric with large electrostriction. However, electro-mechanic way of control might have a restriction in the speed of operation. This question is estimated by the microwave investigation of relaxor ceramics. Several designs of tunable microwave devices are discussed.

articleTitle: Multiplexing of digital information in VHF maritime radiotelephony
abstract: The complex system for covered transmission of digital information in standard VHF maritime radiotelephone channels is designed on the basis of digital watermarking (DWM) technology. Audio imperceptibility and interference stability of multiplexed digital data are provided with application of OFDM and ISS algorithms in cooperation with new methods of normalized distribution of introduced distortions and data block detection using hash functions. It is based on OFDM modulation and ISS method with new methods of insertion interferences distribution and data packet detection with a hash function. Experiments are carried out for signal transmission in the real VHF radio channel using SAILOR RT-2048 radio station and USB-module E14-140M L-CARD for off-line MatLab processing. The designed DWM system provides data transmission rate of 60 bit/sec at 4 dB from additive noise in a standard VHF radio channel maintaining resistance to intersymbol and amplitude distortions. The design method is intended for implementation of radiotelephone transmissions automatic identification in maritime communication without standard radio equipment replacing, additional frequency-time resources allocation and altering the adopted radio communication procedures.

articleTitle: Magnetic nanocomposites for EHF range
abstract: Magnetic composites based on barium hexaferrite (BaFe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">19</sub>) nanopowder have been fabricated and investigated. Samples with 50 weight % of nanopowder have been manufactured with magnetic bias (“oriented composite”) as well as without bias (“non-oriented composite”); the magnetic susceptibility temperature dependence, hysteresis loops, and the natural FMR spectra have been studied.

articleTitle: Adaptive changing of UAV digital communication systems parameters
abstract: The problems of adaptive changing of UAV digital communication systems parameters are discussed. The author gives the short link budget analysis and proposes the main thesis of adaptive changing of UAV communication systems parameters.

articleTitle: Software for equivalent circuit parameters' extraction of MMIC passive components
abstract: Software tools for extraction of equivalent circuits of MMIC passive components are described. It is included into INDESYS-MS measurement automation system.

articleTitle: Information-extreme cluster-analysis for self-learning GRID-centers
abstract: The problem of analyzing and synchronizing the self-learning decision-making support system (DMSS) which is used in a telecommunication system as a GRID-service center is being discussed within the scope of the information-extreme intellectual technology.

articleTitle: Determination of optical depth levels of photosensitive paramagnetic centers in wide-GaP semicoductor materials by means of microwave method
abstract: With the help of EPR-method the optical depth levels of photosensitive paramagnetic centers in ZnS:Al crystals had been determined.

articleTitle: Implementation of multi-layered semidisk dielectric resonators to the measurement of troposphere refraction coefficient
abstract: The possibility of development of prospective sensors of troposphere refraction coefficient on the basis of multi-layered semidisk dielectric resonators is investigated. Electrodynamic characteristics of resonators with the amount of semidisks from one to five are investigated. On frequency 33 GHz the high differential sensitiveness of sensor, making 16 kHz on one N unit of index of refraction without the increase of radiation Q-factor of resonator, is attained.

articleTitle: Characteristics of radar signals scattered by convective thermal processes in the troposphere
abstract: The spectral and statistical characteristics of radar reflections from the convective thermal processes in the troposphere based on the results of the annual cycle of radar observations are considered.

articleTitle: The investigations of the response of midlatitude ionospheric D-region to power atmospheric front
abstract: It was experimentally found that almost in half of cases of atmospheric front (AF) passages quasi-periodic changes in A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">o, x</sub>(z, t) and A<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">no, x</sub>(z, t) take place, due to the passage of infrasonic waves. This processes changed its height with velocity of 300-350 m/s. It was also established that during the passage of AF in the bottom of the D-region (z <; 80 km) electron density values N (z, t) were underestimated by a factor of 1.2-2.2 as compared with control days.

articleTitle: TWT collector region as a source of microwave radiation
