abstract: An experimental study of the generation of broadband noise-like oscillations in the collector of a traveling wave tube (TWT) have been considered. The analysis of experimental results shows that injected into in the collector region of TWT multispeed electron beam is source of broadband noiselike oscillations. It is established that the maximum cumulative capacity, removable from the collector region of TWT is 12 W, the maximum frequency of generation is 7 GHz, the maximum bandwidth Δf /f ~ 0.8. It is shown that the traveling-wave tube with a collector-generator can operate both an as amplifier and an external signal generator.

articleTitle: Phenomenological theory of induced magnetic anisotropy in ferrite films
abstract: The expression for magnetoelastic energy density of saturated ferromagnetic dielectric with cubic symmetry has been theoretically analyzed. Mechanical stress induced changes of magnetocrystalline anisotropy constants have been derived, based on 3-parametric anisotropy model. An experimental radiospectroscopic method of magnetoelastic coupling coefficients determination has been suggested.

articleTitle: 100 nm pHEMT MMIC technology
abstract: A robust and manufacturable high-performance 100-nm gate length AlGaAs/InGaAs pseudomorphic High-Electron Mobility Transistor (pHEMT) process is presented.

articleTitle: Surface-charge and -current densities induced by moderately relativistic particle in cylindrical drift-tube
abstract: Using the Darwin model and method of Green's function, we calculate the surface-charge and -current densities induced by a moderately relativistic point-like charged-particle that moves arbitrarily in a grounded, ideally conducting, unbounded circular cylindrical drift-tube. Results of analytical derivation of the quasi-static (evanescent, i.e. propagating with the speed of the point-like charge) electric and magnetic fields, which constitute together the complete space-charge field of moderately relativistic charged-particle, are presented. We explore the applicability of obtained expressions for numerical modelling of totally three-dimensional dynamics of charged-particle beams using the point-to-point interaction (PPI) method in the moderately relativistic - the first post-Newtonian - approximation.

articleTitle: Tunable gyrotron on the wave H01 with reflective filters
abstract: The possibility of a gyrotron operating on H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> wave with reflective waveguide filters. Electron efficiency of the device can reach 30% and full efficiency of 80%.

articleTitle: The growth of carp underyearling after microwave treatment of its reproductive products
abstract: The results of exploratory researches of a microwave stimulation on carp's reproductive products (fish roe which is fecundated with soft roes) on growth of its underyearling are given.

articleTitle: On the division of modes in the multilayer dielectric structure with microstrip elements
abstract: It is shown on the basis of solutions of Maxwell's equations that in the multilayer dielectric electrodynamics structure of the open or closed type with microstrip metal or dielectric elements of final sizes there is generally a division of waves on LE and LM modes.

articleTitle: Reduction of inter-channel and inter-symbol interferences in communication channels with frequency-separated users
abstract: Physically realized equidistant, orthogonal with periodical weight functions are used for signal approximation. It is demonstrated that such approach allows to reduce the level of inter-channel and inter-symbol interferences.

articleTitle: Description of a GaN transistor quasimonolitic integrated circuit of the 4–18 GHz distilated amplifier
abstract: A description is given of the results obtained from developing the GaN quasi-monolithic IC (QMIC) for the 4-18 GHz distributed amplifier built upon the AlGaN/AlN/GaN heterostructures grown upon sapphire substrates. Design features and frequency responses are presented.

articleTitle: Structural properties of nano-textured ZnO films deposited by CBD-method
abstract: In this work the structural characteristics of ZnO nano-textured films deposited by CBD-method are investigated. Examination of layers morphology and structure was performed by high-resolution electron microscopy and X-ray diffraction method respectively.

articleTitle: Application of external synchronization for increasing noise stability in homodyne reception of optical signals
abstract: In the infrared range of wavelengths λ = 1 ... 6 microns the use of an external injection synchronization based on the cylindrical lens (CL) with tunable parameters, to improve noise stability in homodyne reception of optical signals, was investigated.

articleTitle: Simulation of the satellite network for the service on the territory of the Ukraine in the Ka band
abstract: An example of satellite network coverage of planning and calculation of the antenna with the contour pattern in the Ka band is presented.

articleTitle: Features of the system analysis at automation of intellectual professional activity
abstract: There are intellectual activities where automation is required to support specialists in acceptance of crucial decisions. Intellectual tasks demand the careful analysis of data and use the knowledge formed by experts. The proposed upgrading of the system analysis provides effective updating of knowledge and long support of intellectual software as a whole.

articleTitle: Model of the higher-power microwave chaotic oscillator
abstract: A chaos oscillator model built around a highpower bipolar transistor and lumped elements has been proposed and investigated in a software ADS package.

articleTitle: Quasi-optical cylindrical dielectric resonator as refractometer sensor
abstract: The possibility of application of cylindrical dielectric resonator with "whispering gallery" modes as a sensor for determination of air permittivity is studied. In a millimeter-wave band the numerical investigation of Teflon resonator eigen parameters were carried out at change of air permittivity within (1...1.1). It is shown that frequency sensitivity of a resonator with TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3610</sub> and TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3620</sub> modes is respectively 90 Hz and 150 Hz at changeless values of Q-factors 4870 and 457, when air permittivity is increased by 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup>.

articleTitle: Measurement of anisotropic dielectrics in the semi-opened waveguide structures
abstract: The electrodynamical computing model of waveguide junctions with anisotropic filling is designed. This model is focused on the evaluation of electrical properties of monocrystalline dielectrics in the microwave band. The technique of measurement of the components of the permittivity tensor of uniaxial anisotropic crystals is offered.

articleTitle: Differential radar cross section of spheroidal water drops
abstract: Calculation of scattering signatures of a spheroidal water drop on the base of Pruppacher's model was performed. It is shown that differential RCS is practically the same for spheroidal and spherical drops. This confirms validity of using a spherical shape of drops for calculation of their scattering signatures by Mie theory.

articleTitle: Plasma cyclotron maser with a magneto-compressional pumping
abstract: Тhe capabilities of modern vacuum electronic devices with respect to accumulation of energy in an “active substance” and control of the duration of resultant electromagnetic radiation are constrained by the interaction time of an electron beam with the radiation limited by the beam transit through a resonator. Using non-equilibrium plasma as an active substance opens new possibilities for long-lasting accumulation of energy in a resonator volume with subsequent release of this energy in the form of a short pulse of electromagnetic radiation. Energy may be effectively pumped by a magnetic compression in time resulting in formation of non-equilibrium energetic tails in the electron distribution function [1]. The energy of fast electrons may be released as coherent maser electromagnetic radiation due to development of electron cyclotron (EC) instabilities caused by the anisotropy of the electron distribution function. The radiation frequency is determined by the magnetic field strength at the moment when the instability develops, and therefore can be varied in wide limits. Realization of such modes in a plasma device faces essential difficulties because the accumulation time of energetic electrons exceeds by many orders of magnitude the instability growth times, what causes a premature release of the energy before it is accumulated. These difficulties were partially overcome in [3], where a new mode of generation was proposed being based on excitation of oblique fast extraordinary waves in rarefied plasma. It was found that development of the cyclotron instabilities may be refrained by dense background plasma, what has been confirmed by a laboratory experiment on detecting the cyclotron instabilities on a decay phase of a pulsed ECR discharge in a mirror trap discussed in the present paper, which continues our early work [2]. These results open good prospects for development of a new class of sources of pulsed electromagnetic radiation, in particular, in the terahertz frequency range poorly mastered by classic vacuum electronics devices.

articleTitle: Space distribution of gyrotron under the influence of reflections from the remote load
abstract: The design principles and technology of fabricating sensitive microwave detectors on the basis of low barrier (0.2-0.3 eV) Schottky diodes are developed. A family of diodes and diode-based broadband detectors featuring 1000-5000 V/W sensitivity and 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-11</sup> W Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1/2</sup> threshold power at millimeter wavelengths and zero-bias operation are fabricated.

articleTitle: Effect of information component of inaccurate continuous measurements of signal characteristics qubit-detectors with parametric transformation of energy
abstract: The model of an inaccurate continuous measurement of parametric energy conversion in the charge-phase qubit-detector of Rabi oscillation modes is presented. Apart from the inductive interaction of the qubit, the measuring circuit allows for the effect of continuous partial collapse of the qubit state with its inaccurate measurement. The present article considers the case of practically pure continuous inaccurate measurement of the signal qubit detector characteristics operating in a parametric energy conversion mode. To describe it we have used a previously developed [3] information approach to characterizing the dynamics of the afore-mentioned type of measurement based upon the the quantum Bayes theorem. We have also proposed a principle of invariance for a classical trajectory of the detector in the course of the continuous inaccurate measurement in relation to the mode of qubit quantomechanic description [4].

articleTitle: The gyroton — Frequency multiplier simulation
abstract: Optimal modes are identified and the limit parameters of frequency gyroton-multiplier, in which the same signal level is 2-4-fold multiplication of frequency with electronic efficiency more than 79%, are found. The optimal parameters and analysis of output characteristics of two-cascade gyrotons are described.

articleTitle: Determining the instantaneous frequency of the non-stationary process of electroencephalogram type
abstract: Implementation of the electroencephalograms (EEG) is considered. signal It is shown that EEG can be presented as a signal with stochastic frequency modulation. The spectra of implementations and a time-frequency dependences are calculated fro the zero level cross points.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of frequency dependent on group delay time of Control Microstrip Line on Semiconductor Substrate
abstract: In this work we present results of numerical simulation of frequency dependents of group delay time (FD GDT) of Control Microstrip Line on Semiconductor Substrate (CMLSS) for microwave range 6-14 GHz. There were given structures and equivalent circuits of CMLSS. We discussed the problem of possibility for using CMLSS as Control Group Delay Time Equalizer (CGDTE) for microwave frequency.

articleTitle: Investigation of the frequency characteristics of the electrodes for EEG measurement at high frequencies
abstract: The paper considers the problem of determining the applicability of the electrocardiographic electrodes to human brain electrical activity monitoring at high frequencies. Frequency response of the electrodes and their circuit models were investigated. The dependence of voltage transmission coefficient of the electrode at high frequencies is linear and does not contain any significant fluctuations, which allows using them for electroencephalogram recording in the range from 0 to 1 kHz.

articleTitle: Overload simulation for output queue TCP/IP router
abstract: In order to study the state of congestion in the TCP/IP networks designed discrete nonlinear system. The adequacy of the developed system is confirmed. Can be used for the synthesis of robust controllers for queue management.

articleTitle: 15 W output power amplifier with 8.5–12.5 GHz frequency band on the base of GaN QMIC's
abstract: This paper presents the design and measured characteristics of QMIC and module, as well as the results of development of the output GaN quasi-monolithic IC (QMIC) and the open-frame hybrid-integrated amplifier module on its base with the output power of 15 W in 8.5-12.5 GHz frequency band.

articleTitle: Doherty amplifier using GaN MESFET NPTB00025
abstract: 1 GHz microwave Doherty power amplifier (PA) using GaN MESFET NPTB00025 was designed. Influence of input power dividing ratio and negative gate bias voltages ratio of two class-B PAs on whole Doherty scheme characteristics was simulated. An amplifier delivers 25 W of output power with 69.8% efficiency and 20 V of supply voltage.

articleTitle: Efficiency of shielding of electromagnetic radiation by nanoporous polymerous materials
abstract: Polymerous water-containing material based on the cross-linked polymerous hydrogel soaked in inorganic salt and put into the container made of polyamide films is designed. Frequency dependence on the reflectance coefficient of EMR is obtained in the range of 8.0...12.0 GHz at temperature range from minus 15 to plus 50°C.

articleTitle: Investigation of the self-similar structure of the hybrid coating surface Al2O3/TiN
abstract: New experimental results are presented on the structure and phase composition of hybrid coatings, which were deposited on a substrate of AISI 321 stainless steel using a combination of plasma-detonation and subsequent High-Current Electron Beam (HCEB) treatment. Statistical parameters are calculated within two dimensional multifractal detrended fluctuation analyses. It is shown that the generalized Hurst exponent of the surface under modification is determined by a beam current.

articleTitle: Principles of optimization of the choice of points of navigation and space provisions
abstract: Criteria of a choice and optimization of reference points for system of navigation and space provisions of the Ukraine are supposed. Scalar and vector criteria of a choice are compared. Influence of a configuration of placement basic and predicted points on quality of a forecast is analyzed.

articleTitle: Microwave immitance logical elements
abstract: Theoretical substantiation of the basic parameters of immitance logical elements such as speed, the coefficient of association for the input, the coefficient of stability, power consumption is carried out. The analytical expressions for these parameters, which are used for the implementation of LE on the bipolar and field-polar transistor structures are obtained.

articleTitle: Impedance spectroscopy of semiconductor heterojunctions
abstract: The quantitative analysis of the impedance of nonideal heterojunctions was carried out taking into consideration the effects of series resistance, shunt resistance, parasitic inductance and electrically active interface traps. A new approach is proposed to determine the energy distribution of surface state density and to calculate the actual value of barrier capacitance of heterojunctions on the basis of the analysis of their complex impedance-voltage characteristics.

articleTitle: Scientific knowledge portals seen as rapid strides in producing semantic Web
abstract: The Scientific Knowledge portals that are created by competent experts rest upon well-made and appropriately structured metadata. The present paper describes these portals as a progressive advance towards ground-breaking semantic Web technologies. There is some clear evidence that in the process of producing the knowledge portals certain conflicting views are observed to emerge between developers of programs and their users. We suggest some kind of technological approach to brining their specific interests or objectives in line with up-to-date standards, and to this end we think it sensible to get both categories of specialists to actively participate in cooperative conferences on wide-ranging issues. Below is given a specific an example of this type of participation.

articleTitle: Measurement of conductivity and thickness of semiconductor wafers by means of microwave photonic structures
abstract: The technique of simultaneously determination of thickness and electrical conductivity of structures based on semiconductor layers, which play a role of the irregularity in one-dimensional waveguide photonic crystals has been developed. The experimental results and the inverse problem solving are presented.

articleTitle: Observation of radiotelescope RT22 CrAo with the Synthetic Aperture Radar ENVISAT from space
abstract: The RT22 CrAO radio telescope antenna has been observed with a C-band Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) for the purpose of deriving scattering properties and pointing information. Space-based radars benefit from accurate calibration targets and for the lower frequency bands such targets can be rather large in physical sense in order to derive level information. Active transponders are used. A large reflector antenna has a scattering pattern, which depends on a number of properties and compares with the actual radiation pattern of the antenna (minimum scattering antenna, depending on loading considerations). We have done preliminary investigations by measuring the responses with the SAR on-board ENVISAT.

articleTitle: Microwave subsurface tomography and holography
abstract: Method of scanning tomography and holography of subsurface dielectric objects based on inverse scattering problem solution for the pseudopulse synthesized by multifrequency measurements of scattered field is studied.

articleTitle: Dependence of coaxial gyro-BWO efficiency vs. transversal and longitudinal waveguide dimensions
abstract: In this report we investigated dependence of efficiency vs. transversal and longitudinal waveguide dimensions for profiling guiding magnetic field of gyro-BWO generator.

articleTitle: Lyapunov exponent calculation for microwave systems: Choice of quantities for system state
abstract: In the current work, the problem of the choice of the spatially extended system main state for calculating of the spectrum of Lyapynov exponents is considered. It has been shown that (due to the particularities of the system) the number of quantities included into the system state may be reduced.

articleTitle: Kinetic properties and factor thermoelectric figure of merit of crystals Hg1−x−yMnxDyyTe
abstract: The paper presents research results of the kinetic properties and the coefficient of thermoelectric figure of merit of crystals Hg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-x-y</sub>Mn<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</sub>Dy<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</sub>Te.

articleTitle: Restoration algorithm of the depth distribution of electrophysical properties of semiconductors in microwave microscopy
abstract: Restoration algorithm of the depth distribution of the electrical properties of semiconductor materials and products in the method of microwave scanning is studied. In order to process the information obtained by varying the thickness of the air gap, an iterative method of successive perturbations is used.

articleTitle: Selection of modes in a submillimeter gyrotron with a corrugated cavity wall
abstract: The present paper concerns the principle of selection based on the use of a corrugated axisymmetric cavity with the corrugation depth smoothly varying along the axis.

articleTitle: Suppression of the slot oscillation mode in coaxial magnetrons the millimetric range wavelengths
abstract: Methods for a slot oscillation mode reactive suppression in coaxial magnetrons (CM) are considered. The limitations of the existing methods to calculate the slot - type frequency are presented. One modified version of calculations and one novel method applicable to the anode slow-wave system whose thickness of the peripheral wall is over 0.1λ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</sub> are shown. Reactive “destruction” of the HF-field space harmonic of slot-type oscillation is considered in the process of manufacturing rectangular coupling slots of a variable height.

articleTitle: Life in the fundamental notions of the physics of the alive
abstract: In the notions of the physics of the alive the self-functioning living objects are the entirety quantum-mechanical systems occupied the fourth step of the quantum ladder of nature — after nuclear, atomic and molecular ones (the Weisskopf's classification [1]). The self-consistent potentials of living objects, ensuring the quantum-mechanical scenario of the life, are realized in accordance with a genome as the coherent eigenfields in mm-range of electromagnetic waves. Such a fields — electromagnetic models of the alive (specificly human being) due to force of coherence possess of the super-stability, which permits them to check and maintain the retranslation of genome on organism permanently through the standard mechanisms of biochemical heredity. The stability of organisms in the variable environment (temperature, pressure, humidity and so on) is achieved in nature by existence in the superconductivity (due to coherence) electromagnetic, framework of the alive the “normal threads” (trajectories of Poincare's limit eyeles — Chinese meridians), ensuring the superconductivity just the second type [2]. The diseases which cannot be overcomed by organism itself arise exclusively through the deformation of self-consistent potential which retranslates the genome, i.e. by meants of creation of metastable states. Elimination of these states, realized by solitary quanta with using of methods of nuclear, atomic and molecular spectroscopy, is ensured with the technologies of the quantum medicine. As a result the sciences about the alive — and, in the first place, biology and medicine — have being received the possibility to become the fundamental sciences.

Author Keywords: the nature of Chinese meridians and points of acupuncture
electromagnetic model in the problem of realization of genome

articleTitle: Changes in the biophysical properties of water following exposure to a passive log periodic antenna
abstract: Passive log periodic antenna was used as an environment factor to influence the growth of wheat grains. The number of shoots decreased considerably and they were worse developed. The results obtained were being compared with a development of wheat grains grown without the passive antenna. The increase of the pH level of the spring bottled water following exposure to the passive antenna has been established. It can be assumed that little-known quantum properties of the EM radiation together with the supplementing properties of water are responsible for the obtained non-thermal biological effects.

articleTitle: Intersymbol and interchannel interference with a mobile terminal moving at hight speed
abstract: The paper presents the results of investigation into the intersymbol and interchannel interference on an autobahn when a mobile terminal moves at a speed of up to 300 km/h.

articleTitle: Sliding-sweep soft-decoding of nonbinary linear block codes
abstract: A backward (BW) algorithm to generate the optimum syndrome trellis for soft-decision decoding of non-binary linear block codes is proposed. The BW-algorithm is an inherent part of the elaborated sliding-sweep method to simplify the aposteriori probabilities (APP) calculus. Decision making is based on log-likelihood ratio (LLR).

articleTitle: Nickel — Alumina nanostructures formation by electrochemical processing for high-density data storage devices
abstract: The features of uniform nickel electrochemical deposition into the pores of thin ordered porous anodic alumina (PA) are considered. The influence of deposition conditions on ordering and topological parameters of nickel nanopillars are investigated. The impact of the barrier layer thinning process at the PA pores bottom on the origination and growth of the ordered metal nanopillars is discussed.

articleTitle: Pulse evolution at passing via multiplexers of optical communication system
abstract: Various kinds of the optical pulse shapes at their passing through band pass filters of the multiplexer and demultiplexer were studied. Rectangular and Gaussian, as well as soliton-like and super-Gaussian pulses are analyzed. The requirements are stated for pulse parameters and both for filters and sources of fiber-optic communication systems.

articleTitle: Multi-channel adaptive algorithm for acoustic noise suppression of DFT method in systems voice messaging
abstract: In this paper we consider adaptive linear multichannel filtering of speech signals and the suppression of the components of external acoustic noise by DFT method.

articleTitle: Plane helical antennas in dielectric medium
abstract: The influence of medium material parameters on the radiation characteristics of a plane helical antenna are investigated using the method of integral equations for thin conductors.

articleTitle: Effective power supply for ultra wide band mobile radars
abstract: The principles of building the power supply system for the ultra wide band (UWB) mobile radars elaborated. They are based upon the utilization of the electrochemical capacitors (EC). The block diagram (function circuit) of these radars was refined through the use of a new assembly unit that comprises ECs and a voltage converter. This arrangement made it possible to increase the output power, diminish the pulse duration and raise an efficiency of sounding pulse oscillators in UWB pulsed radars.

articleTitle: L-band AESA radiating element
abstract: A new design of the radiating element that made it possible to produce AESA with the mass of the emitting sheet is not more than 14 Kg. The designed RE is a compact, universal structure that has the characteristics of the radiation with a gain of more than 11 dB and the axial ratio of at least 0.7 in the frequency band from 1.1 to 1.7 GHz. The dimensions of the L-band AESA radiating element do not exceed the length of the wave. The measurements of the AESA element radiating accurately coincide with the calculations made with a method of the topological synthesis-based upon numerical methods.

articleTitle: Balun integral circuits design
abstract: Several versions of microwave balun intended for SiGe Integrated circuits have been investigated.

articleTitle: Analysis of the fine structure of distributions of solar system's small bodies' orbits. Near Earth asteroids
abstract: There are theories which state that a space of possible orbits in gravitational systems of planetary type is discrete, so there are systems of stable and unstable orbits. A discrete structure of gravitational systems of planetary type should be evident in distributions of orbital energy, angular momentum and some elements of orbits. The easiest way to test such theories is to look for harmonic components in frequency histograms of semi-major axes.

articleTitle: Simulation of graded-gap ALInN Gunn diodes
abstract: We have obtained output characteristics of graded-gap AlInN diodes with different cathode contacts in a wide range of frequencies (fig. 1, table 1). The graded-gap AlInN TEDs can effectively operate in the microwave frequency generation mode up to 0.9 ÷ 1.3 THz. For similar InN-diodes the frequency limit is 0.7 ÷ 0.8 THz. Optimal length of the graded-gap AlInN layer, depending on the active region length and the doping profile is within the range of 0.2 to 0.8 μm. The graded-gap AlInN TEDs exceed InN TEDs of the same type with respect to generation efficiency and output power, but are inferior to them in the optimal generation frequency. Power consumption of AlInN TEDs with high-ohmic heterogeneity at cathode and active region length less than 0.8 μm is by 3 ÷ 20% less than in the InN TEDs of the same type. Within the considered frequency range AlN diodes are inferior to InN and graded gap AlInN TEDs in efficiency, output power and power consumption, as well as in the optimal generation frequency.

articleTitle: Modeling the temperature distribution of biological objects
abstract: A mathematical model of temperature distribution of biological objects, which can be used in the diagnosis of tumor diseases in human tissues. To solve the problem the equations of elliptic type, in particular, the Laplace equation in homogeneous environments, are used. As a model of a biological object a flat three-layer structure with different dielectric permittivities is adopted.

articleTitle: The experimental setup for analyzing the characteristics of nonlinearity of objects as impacted by the picosecond duration pulse
abstract: The experimental setup for analyzing the characteristics of nonlinearity of objects in the pulse mode with picosecond duration signals is developed.

articleTitle: IEEE conference activity of Ukraine in 2003–2012 (for the 100th anniversary of the IRE)
abstract: The analysis of the conference activity of Ukraine in IEEE during 2003–2012 is carried out. The most active regions, the Crimea and Lvov, are marked out.

articleTitle: Evaluating the influence of mobile user movement speed upon the throughput of a UMTS network cell
abstract: A simulation of the 3-rd generation UMTS network was performed and the influence of mobile user's movement speed upon the total network cell capacity was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Resonant measuring trasducers on the basis of typical cavity resonators
abstract: The results of researches of properties of resonant measuring transducers on the basis of the prismatic and cylindrical resonators excited in oscillation modes H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10n</sub> and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">011</sub>, intended for use in the scanning microwave microscopy are resulted.

articleTitle: On the mechanism of recovery effect of electromagnetic waves of low intensity on cell cultures subjected to ionizing radiation
abstract: The theoretic explanation of the results of experimental studies in which there was demonstrated the recovery effect of millimeter electromagnetic waves on cells influenced by gamma-irradiation. It was shown that diffusion transport of substances, the export of the toxic products of lipid peroxidation from cell and import of antioxidants in the opposite direction, is realized in a cell. The air bubbles in the water layer near a cell membrane react to microwave irradiation and make near-membrane water layer less dense. This lowers the rate of degradation of the membrane caused by ionizing radiation.

articleTitle: PKD instrument for “INGL” experiment
abstract: PKD (Ka-band receiver) instrument, a part of science payload of “Luna-Glob” mission spacecraft, is designed for navigational task and “INGL” experiment. The “INGL” experiment involves a gravity field measurement around “Luna-Glob” and “Luna-Resource” moon probe landing locations. The instrument receives the landing module beacon signal to accurately and precisely measure the changes in the spacecraft speed around beacon using Doppler frequency shift. The accuracy of the experiment is determined by the frequency stability of the beacon ultra-stable oscillator and the Doppler shift measurement accuracy of the PKD instrument. With the 30 seconds accumulation time, overall beacon and receiver frequency instability will be about 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-13</sup>, leading to 0.003 Hz signal frequency measurement error at Ka-band and acceleration measurement error of about 3 mGal.

articleTitle: Equipment of the Station «krim» for monitoring of solar activity in radiorange
abstract: In accordance with recommendation of UN [1] for providing of continuous observations of the Sun round-the-clock the Crimean observatory conducts observations in those hours of days, when other observatories of the World network [2] are on the nightly side of the Earth. The radio telescopes of CrAO are operated on 4 discrete frequencies 9, 6, 2.8, 2.5 GHz, and in a range of 350-250 MHz. The results are published in http://www.crao.crimea.ua and are transmitted online to the International data center ESA for operative diagnostics of solar flares.

articleTitle: Design of interactive web-systems' construction using javascript
abstract: The article presents the architecture of the model functioning of a web site with some elements of interactive UI. An approach to the creation of the interface architecture, based on the browser version and the presence in it JavaScript, which is turned on, is also studied.

articleTitle: The built-in measuring device of passing microwave power level
abstract: The block diagram of high stability passing power level meter is proposed. The digital processing algorithm of measurement signals is developed. The device is designed for built-in control passing power in the microwave radio system path.

articleTitle: The peculiarities of signals selection for the marine radar of continuous sounding
abstract: The approach to the selection of signals for marine continuous radar and search-and-rescue transponder (SART) is presented. The block diagram of processing of such signals is proposed. The selection of the obtained signals allows keeping the advantages of continuous operation, such as lower level of output emission, high electromagnetic compatibility, and to ensure the operation of the existing SART's.

articleTitle: Field theory of the non-additive systems
abstract: On the basis of quantum-field methods the statistical theory of the complex nano-scale systems, whose thermodynamic potentials do not have the property of additivity, was developed. It is shown that taking into account the non-additivity parameter for the statistical distribution does not change the equations of evolution, while the probability of different phase trajectories depends strongly on this parameter.

articleTitle: Waveguide wave-excited ferrite resonator (analytical solution)
abstract: The rigorous analytical solution of the problem of ferrite resonator waveguide waves excitation in the rectangular waveguide for any relationships between a wave length, geometrical dimensions and material parameters of the giromagnetic medium is obtained.

articleTitle: The influence of temperature on the drift velocity of electron in semiconductor superlattice under influence of the tilted magnetic field
abstract: The dependence of the drift velocity vs. the intensity of the electric field is discussed. The influence of a tilted magnetic field and the temperature on the electron dynamics in the semiconductor superlattice is studied.

articleTitle: Measurement of complex permittivity of the highly absorbing liquids based on a two-layer circular waveguide in a wide frequency range
abstract: A waveguide-type cell for measuring the complex permittivity of strongly absorbing liquids in the frequency range of about two octaves is proposed. The cell is formed by a round metal waveguide with a coaxial cylindrical insert made of a dielectric with low losses. The liquid under study fills the space between the insert and the waveguide. The characteristics of modes of a two-layer waveguide with an absorbing layer of liquid are studied by means of numerical solutions of the characteristic equation for the two-layer waveguide. The results of electromagnetic simulation method used to wave excitation in such a cell are presented. The advantages of the proposed cell are compared to the known technical solutions used in the microwave dielectrometry of absorbing liquids.

articleTitle: Morphological features of nanostructured silicon obtained by metal-assisted chemical etching
abstract: The results of research of the morphological characteristics of nanostructured silicon are presented.

articleTitle: Properties of the intermediate mesa structure in deformation methods of obtaining islands of nanostructured silicon
abstract: In this work on the basis of use of modern methods of researches in a combination with methods of chemical selective etching structure the surface layer of silicon consisted of area of polycrystalline silicon and area which contained dislocation grids was studied after oxidation and ion implantation. It is shown that dislocation grids can serve a basis for mesa structure creation in different deformation methods of obtaining nanostructured silicon.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of two-index model of frequency channels distribution in a multichannel mesh-network of IEEE 802.11
abstract: The article introduces a double index model of the distribution frequency channels in the multichannel multiradio wireless mesh-networking standard IEEE 802.11. The influence of stations territorial separation and technological characteristics of multiradio multichannel mesh networking upon the quality of the allocation of channels problem solution are analyzed.

articleTitle: Methods for identifying of targets with reciprocating motion at medical radar construction
abstract: The construction methods of medical radars, designed for indentifying the trajectory of a mechanical movement of a man's chest, as well as features of reciprocating moving targets detection radar, are considered.

articleTitle: Method of software quality management based on functional point metrics
abstract: Proposed method for estimating the parameters of cost and time of project development using functional points. The simulation showed the advantage of the proposed method over the expert evaluation of these parameters.

articleTitle: Temperature control of the fiber-optic communication lines
abstract: The methods of determining the presence of high temperature areas in fiber-optic communication lines are presented. The graphs of OTDR are presented. The dependence of their characteristics vs. wavelength is underlined.

articleTitle: Investigation of the wireless ZigBee modules characteristics during their indoor operation
abstract: The paper presents the results of the experimental investigation of the wireless ZigBee modules characteristics, obtained by creation an automated system for monitoring of electrical parameters in 2012.

articleTitle: On the issue of sensitivity enhancement for null radiometers with combined pulse modulation
abstract: The principle of time division in multi-receiving radiometric systems of the null method of measurements with the composite impulse modulation, allowing increasing fluctuation sensitivity of systems, is described for the case when long term and temperature stability, as well as dynamic properties, are kept. The diagram of the two-channel radiometer and the description of a principle of time division for the multichannel diagram are presented.

articleTitle: Application of sensitivity coefficients for accuracy determination of coordinates calculation by means of radiolocation passive systems
abstract: The method of sensitivity coefficients being used as numerically calculated partial derivatives for estimation of absolute values of coordinates inaccuracy with help of range-difference method in systems of passive radar-location is offered. It is shown that sensitivity coefficients are an effective tool for area determination, in which with the set probability a radio emission source can be. In turn, it gives the possibility of construction of radio monitoring expert systems.

articleTitle: Some optical and substructural properties of ZnS nanostructures
abstract: In this paper some substructural and optical properties of zinc sulfide nanostructures obtained by CSVS-method on bulk-ZnSe are investigated. Examination of optical and substructural properties was performed by infrared spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction method respectively.

articleTitle: Waveguide-dielectric resonator with resonance plunger
abstract: The possibility of the eigen Q-factor increase for the waveguide-dielectric resonator (WDR) in the condition of the resonance frequency tuning using the resonance moving short-circuit plunger has been shown.

articleTitle: Millimeter and submillimeter range oscillators and amplifiers of on orbotron-klystrons with electron sheet beams
abstract: Modelling of oscillators and amplifiers of a millimeter and submillimeter range is spent. The mathematical model in which the space-charge of sheet beam and sagging of fields in gaps are considered. It is shown, that the calculation electron efficiency of orbotron-klystrons of oscillators at frequencies 100-200 GHz can reach 1-6 %.

articleTitle: Diffraction of TEM-wave by array of two slots in a plate-parallel waveguige wall
abstract: The TEM-wave diffraction problem is solved analytically using an array of two slots in a thick waveguide wall. The solution is obtained in a way of the system of four linear algebraic equations for unknown field amplitudes. Calculation results of scattering characteristics (reflection and transmission coefficients, far field directional pattern) are shown and analyzed.

articleTitle: Detecting people using ring aperture microwave imaging
abstract: Presented in this paper is the technique of people detection using microwave imaging system with ring aperture. The essence of the technique is extracting heartbeat and breath signals from the time sequence of reconstructed images. The modeling conducted proved the efficiency of this technique.

articleTitle: Omnidirectional antenna with a radiation field of circular polarization
abstract: The results of the development of an antenna with circular polarization of the radiation field, omnidirectional radiation pattern in the azimuth plane and the narrow radiation pattern in the elevation plane with a maximum displacement of the radiation from the horizon at an angle of 30° are presented.

articleTitle: Statistical analysis and influence estimation of electrical and structural parameters of transmitting subsystem of wireless power transmission to remote objects based on multi-position system of emitters with radiation focusing
abstract: The analysis of influence of electric and structural parameters of transmitting subsystem of wireless power transmission (WPT) to remote ground objects on the basis of the multi-position system of emitters (MSE) with the spatial-phase-frequency focusing of single-stage discrete (SSD) V-type of multifrequency radioimpulses is presented. Requirements to the values of a maximal possible error on the location of emitters' phase centers co-ordinates in MST, errors on setting of initial phases and carrier frequencies on emitters for maximal value of transferrable density power providing in focusing point of rectenna in WPT receiving subsystem are brought.

articleTitle: Kharkiv automated meteor radio system “MARS”: Its historical significance in radio astronomy
abstract: In this paper the scientific achievements and historical facts are briefly outlined. A good deal of work was carried out by Kharkiv (Ukraine) researches under the guidance of Prof. B. L. Kashcheyev who had a made a truly tangible contribution to meteor astronomy. This research team had succeeded in gathering ample evidence on meteor exploration, especially when using the so-called radar method that was suggested by Prof. B.L. Kashcheyev. As far back as 1957 the radar system referred to as “MARS” proved to be quite efficient and by now this particular technique has been internationally rated the best in this field. There is good reason to consider the Kharkiv meteor radar system to be of historical significance in terms of exploring new phenomena in meteor astronomy.

articleTitle: Intermediate Ag layer influence on the diffusion phase formation processes at heat treatment in nanoscaled films compositions Fe50Pt50/Ag/Fe50Pt50
abstract: The additional Ag layer influence on the phase formation in Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>Pt<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>/Ag/ Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub>Pt<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">50</sub> thin metallic films was investigated by methods of physical materials science.

articleTitle: National Satellite Communication System of the Ukraine
abstract: We present some characteristics and parameters of the created National Satellite Communications System of the Ukraine (NSCSU).

articleTitle: Generation of powerful microwave voltage oscillation in diffused SI diode
abstract: Generation of powerful microwave voltage oscillations in a diffused silicon diode has been studied. The reverse current of 2 kA in amplitude passed through 320-μm diode with p-n junction depth of 220 μm, and surface area of 0.5 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. At the average voltage about 300 V and microwave voltage pulse duration of ∼200 ns the voltage swing of the oscillations reaches 480 V. The frequency of the oscillations is 5 to 7 GHz, and power is about 300 kW. In the theoretical analysis it is shown that start of process of oscillations, their swing and frequency are determined by density of a reverse current.

articleTitle: Procedure for updating software of SDR system
abstract: The problems associated with defining the requirements for base stations, which will operate based on SDR-technology6 are considered. Based on these requirements, new SDR-Base Station architecture, which allows reconfigurating the radio access network, is proposed.

articleTitle: Reliability of meteorological information receipt by means of active remote sounding instruments
abstract: For active remote sounding systems (ARSS) the calculation of power budget reserve (PBR) for loss compensation, conditioned by the atmosphere absorption, as a rule, is executed for boundary working conditions. When working at the concrete area, the value of PBR can be of redundant. For the territory of Ukraine 98 percent of long depletion quantile for modern ARSS have been obtained on the basis of the weather statistical data.

articleTitle: Dynamics of high-voltage, subnanosecond discharge in nitrogen at high pressure
abstract: The dynamics of high-voltage pulsed discharge in nitrogen is studied experimentally under the conditions as follows: gas pressure 30 to 60 atm; applied voltage 200 to 400 kV; rise-time of the initial pulse 0.4 to 20 ns. The results are compared with the data of other writers.

articleTitle: Dynamics of frequency of microwave generation of vircator without magnetic field with the interaction space filled with neutral gas
abstract: Results of study of physical processes in the electron beam with a virtual cathode in the interaction space of vircator filled with neutral gas are presented. The mathematical 2D model of self-consistent processes of electron and ion motion, and gas ionization is developed. The basic physical mechanism is defined; the vircator system dynamics in the presence of ions is described. This mechanism is determined by the ion acceleration in the electric field of a moving virtual cathode. With the help of this model the effect of increase of the frequency of microwave generation of the system with the virtual cathode in the case of the excess a certain critical value of gas pressure is observed.

articleTitle: Excitation Efficiency and oscillation Q-factors OF lamellated disk dielectric resonators
abstract: Experimental investigation of electrodynamical characteristics of lamellated disk dielectric resonator, excited on whispering gallery modes, is performed.

articleTitle: 1-mm Wavelength orotron with DRPS and broad electron beam
abstract: The possibility of output power increase in orotron with double-row periodic structure and sphere-cylindrical focusing mirror operating in (140…300) GHz frequency range is demonstrated, when the width of an electron flow achieves the value of 3 radii of caustic. The mirror longitudinal axis of symmetry was oriented parallel to the direction of electron beam.

articleTitle: Simple dipole wide-band instrumentation antenna
abstract: The work concerns the development of a simple small-size instrumentation antenna for measurements of power density and radiation pattern of different RF sources.

articleTitle: The problem of the electron beam transport efficiency in the periodic metal-dielectric channel
abstract: This paper describes the results of the experimental research of the nonrelativistic sheet electron beam passing though the metal-dielectric channel which is formed with metal and metal-dielectric structures.

articleTitle: Microwave cavities for portable EPR spectrometers
abstract: This paper concerns the features of the use of dielectric rods in the form of a truncated cone in the mechanical frequency tuning of rectangular cavities for EPR spectrometers. It is shown that this frequency tuning method offers a far wider linear range of microwave cavity frequency tuning.

articleTitle: Field of the vertical electric dipole over high inductive surface
abstract: The results of experiments on propagation of electromagnetic ground waves of the decameter range (10 and 15 MHz) radiated by vertical electric dipole over the surface of the saline lake covered by an ice on a path of 1.2 km length are considered. It is experimentally established that the field over a high inductive structure is damped sufficiently less than the field over conducting surface. Experimental values of the module of an attenuation function are essentially more than unity and exceed the value of 2. This effect is caused by the ground wave. The data on the ground wave attenuation which were received in the experiment agree with results of numerical calculations of the electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Features of the technique to measure the properties of colloidal and emulsion systems at microwave frequencies
abstract: The features of technology to measure the properties of colloidal and emulsion systems at microwave frequencies have been considered. We have designed a number of coaxial measuring cells. The optimization of the size and construction of coaxial measurement cell size have been carried out. The results of the investigations of test samples of oil, kerosene, colloidal solution of iron oxide, the inverse emulsion (water/kerosene), a dispersion medium which contains iron oxide nanoparticles have been presented.

articleTitle: Routing analysis in the wireless mobile mesh network based on routing protocol AODV
abstract: In this article the simulation model of a mobile wireless network was developed. Estimation of parameters of the routing protocol AODV is made.

articleTitle: A comparative scientometric analysis of papers submitted at international youth conferences "Modern problems of radiotechnics and telecommunicayions" and "Radioelectronics and youth in the XXI-th century"
abstract: A comparative scientometric analysis was carried out of the published papers submitted at Ukrainian youth scientific conferences on radio engineering problems. This comparison was made in terms of the number of papers submitted over the last 4 years. This analysis has shown that a number of publications increased. And an interest in these conferences is kept alive.

articleTitle: Scientist, organizer of scientific educational and inovation activities (In commemoration of the 70th anniversary of the birth of Academician M. Ye. Ilchenko)
abstract: The present short communication is dedicated to the life history of an outstanding researcher, Academician M. Ye. Ilchenko. A special emphasis is placed upon the essential milestones of his different activities involving his genuine devotion to science, his deep commitment to editorial and publishing businesses, social work as well as his production ties and creative contacts with many scientists and related professionals of Sevastopol. The examination of his publications is based upon the elements of bibliometric analysis.

articleTitle: Jet-propulsion microengine based on nanoporous silicon combustion process
abstract: The jet-propulsion microengine has been developed based on porous silicon combustion process. This microengine includes a combustion chamber formed in macropores of a silicon substrate, nozzles based on pyramidal pits and nanoporous silicon impregnated by solid state oxidants as a fuel. The fabricated microengine has shown the mechanical impulse by 20-40% larger with respect to the similar one built without nozzles.

articleTitle: Experimental research of autocorrelation communication system with noise carrier
abstract: A laboratory model of a differential noise-shift-keying communication system was developed. The system uses transferred reference signal and autocorrelation reception. The tests of system performance in a binary, multi-channel and synchronization modes were carried out. Previously proposed methods of signal modulation and signal processing have proved to be effective in experimental studies.

articleTitle: Quasi-optical power combining in the active antenna arrays
abstract: Mutual synchronization of the oscillations in the linear and two-dimensional arrays of log-periodic antennas on the dielectric substrate with field-effect transistors as active elements is experimentally studied. A dielectric reflector is used for broadening of the synchronization frequency band. The opportunity of effective special power combining in the case of two-dimensional array is shown.

articleTitle: ESR spectroscopy employing YIG-Tuned Oscillator in conjunction with low-quality factor resonators
abstract: Electron spin resonance (ESR) is a very useful and robust microwave spectroscopic method with many applications in science and technology. Common microwave sources used in ESR spectroscopy, such as klystrons or Gunn diodes have small bandwidth of ~1GHz (at 10 GHz) and need to be locked on high-Q cavity (Q>;1000) to achieve low phase noise at 100 kHz offset. Here we developed an experimental system with YIG-Tuned Oscillator, which can be used for ESR spectroscopy in the entire range of 8-18GHz and can be locked on relatively low Q resonators (Q>;200). The hysteresis of YIG-Tuned Oscillator does not affects its performance and even at the low Q values one obtains tracking error of the resonator frequency that are ~10-100 kHz.

articleTitle: Electronic calibrator for network vector analyzer
abstract: The electronic calibrator of VNA (vector network analyzer), its block diagram and a method of calibration have been considered. The frequency dependence of standard is measured. The factor verification of calibration is performed.

articleTitle: Design of National Antarctic Data Center internet-portal on the base of ontology
abstract: This paper presents a method of an Internet knowledge portal design in the field of Antarctic research. As a portal's information model ontology is used, it serves to represent the concepts necessary for the understanding of knowledge in the field of Antarctic research, and for running in the framework of its data.

articleTitle: Radar recognition of meteorological objects
abstract: The peculiarities of radar recognition of meteorological objects are considered, when interperiod fluctuations of reflected signals can be described by an autoregressive model. The recognition algorithms based on use of autoregressive or grid filters are presented, parameters of which are determined by these models and estimated on the base of learning samples. The decision of an object type is made up on the base of dispersion minimum of the filter prediction error, when the samples of intensity fluctuations of scattered signals entered into the filter input that corresponds to an object under recognition. The results of the experimental study of radar recognition efficiency of some meteorological objects using the radar are developed. Finally, acceptable practice results for radar recognition of meteorological objects were obtained by Monte Carlo method, when average probability of correct recognition exceeds 0.8. The solving of the radar recognition problem is of great interest for different practical applications, including aircraft flight safety, prevention of hail damage, squalls etc.

articleTitle: Integral and parabolic equation solution for field predicion over the terrain
abstract: Numerical methods for field prediction over the terrain, based on numerical solution of integral and parabolic equations are considered. The results for the real terrain profile are shown.

articleTitle: Analytical estimates of limiting current of charged-particle beam in coaxial drift tube with dielectric insert
abstract: The analytical estimate of the space-charge limited (SCL) current of a charged-particle beam propagating in an infinitely long drift tube with the dielectric insert lining the outer conductor depended on the bias V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sub> applied to the inner conductor of this drift tube is received in the approximation of strong magnetic field. Obtained analytical estimate is compared with the numerical modelling of the SCL current.

articleTitle: Generalized synchronization in two unidirectionally coupled low-voltage vircators
abstract: Generalized synchronization in two unidirectionally coupled low-voltage vircators has been found. The possibility of their application for secure communication has been shown.

articleTitle: Sensitive microwave detectors with two low barrier metal — Semiconductor contacts
abstract: Characteristics of new sensitive microwave detectors with a symmetrical low-barrier structure metal-semiconductor-metal (MSM) are studied. Circuits for connection of detectors to microwave and low frequency registration tracts are discussed. Expressions for volt-watt sensitivity and noise equivalent power are obtained and comparisons with characteristics of zero-bias Schottky (Mott) detectors are performed. The characteristics of symmetric sensing elements are comparable and in some cases superior than the similar parameters of zero-bias detectors.

articleTitle: Wide band TWT generator of UHF chaotic impulses
abstract: This work presents basic characteristics of UHF chaotic ultra wideband generator based on TWT. It is shown that in such generator the chaotic radio-impulses with 3 GHz continuous wideband in 10-cm range and 22.5 W peak power may be produced.

articleTitle: Two-channel microwave power commutator
abstract: The construction of a two-channel microwave power commutator using bulk semiconductors of N- and S-type negative differential conductivity is presented. Besides, the TED-based power microwave modulator and chalcogenide-semiconductor-diode are involved are design is this commutator.

articleTitle: Measurment of distance in near-field the radiolocation in the presence of interfering reflections
abstract: A maximum likelihood method is discussed, which allows improving the accuracy of measuring the distance by means of the near-field radiolocation range finder in the presence of interfering reflection in a certain operating zone.

articleTitle: Evaluation of errors and uncertainties of measurement in SYNC systems
abstract: The basic method of synchronization are considered and the analysis of their algorithms is conducted. The analysis of their algorithm has been carried out. Correlation is given for estimating the shift of scales for standards and errors of basic algorithms. Classification is presented and the methods of estimating measurement uncertainties are proposed.

articleTitle: Multycomponent (Ti-Zr-Hf-V-Nb)N nanostructure coatings fabrication, their properties and structure
abstract: One of the most important tendencies of modern science is creation of new materials, in particular, creation of multicomponent nanocomposite coatings with the grains characteristic dimensions between 2 and 50 nm. Nanocomposite coatings are a new generation of materials. They consist at least of two phases with nanocrystal and/or amorphous structure. Due to small (<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">≤</sub> 10 nm) grain size and more important role of surrounding boundary zones, nanocomposite materials acts differently and show absolutely different properties in comparison with usual materials (with grain sizes ≥100 nm). Therefore, creation of new nanocomposite (nanostructure) coatings is a topical problem.

articleTitle: Analysis of MIMO technology application in satellite communication systems
abstract: Reviewed in this paper is application of MIMO techniques for satellite communications.

articleTitle: Planning of LTE network in urban areas
abstract: Methods of planning LTE network and results of planning for Boryspil city are presented.

articleTitle: Information-extreme algorithm for estimation of telecommunication GRID-system nodes
abstract: The method of state estimation of telecommunication GRID-system nodes to increase effectiveness of allocation tasks planning is proposed. Estimation of current state of GRID-network and utilization of its resources implements within the framework of information-extreme intelligent technology of analysis and synthesis of learning systems.

articleTitle: Hemispherical dielectric resonator with concentric hemispherical hollow for spirit solution investigations
abstract: A new measuring cell for dielectrometry of liquids was suggested. Spirit solutions of different concentration were investigated.

articleTitle: Automated summarization of the volumineous documents (exemplified by dissertation materials)
abstract: A set of methods and algorithms for automated compilation of abstracts of voluminous documents are elaborated. A software package against a dissertation array has been developed. A distinctive feature of this paper is to indicated that the experts who are faced with a heavy inflow of these may well use these methods in their practical work.

articleTitle: The discriminator synthesis of the atmospheric radio acoustic sensing systems
abstract: To simplify existing radioacoustic systems by the number reducing of the correlator channels in the multichannel correlation processing schemes and to increase the estimation accuracy obtained by such systems, it is synthesized the energy information parameter discriminator of radioacoustic systems. The discriminator takes into account the scattered radio signal energy dependence on the sound speed and radiosignal shape change in the scattering on the sound premise.

articleTitle: Dispersive shift in the height of the lower edge of the ionosphere under the influence of strong perturbations in tropospheric conductivity
abstract: In the presence of large mesospheric electric fields (1-10 V/m), great perturbations in tropospheric conductivity act to shift the lower edge of the ionosphere upwards (~4-7 km in the daytime and ~ 5-8 km at night) for VLF radio waves and downwards for HF radio waves (~ 6-8 km at 3 MHz).

articleTitle: Experimental investigation of THz-range gyrotron with a pulsed coil
abstract: The results of experimental investigation of 0.67 THz pulsed gyrotron are presented. The power about 150 kW with efficiency 20% has been demonstrated at 20-microsecond regime in accordance with theoretical estimation.

articleTitle: Simulation of LED devices with high CRI
abstract: The possibilities of obtaining CRI LED devices above 90 by simulating the spectra of standard daylight sources and Planck radiators are analyzed.

articleTitle: Gyrotron at slowed E0i-modes of corrugated waveguide simulation
abstract: Based on modeling and optimization of parameters it is shown, that gyrotron with a slowing E<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0i</sub>-mode of corrugated waveguide is not the worse output characteristics (efficiency, power, gain) than the usual gyrotron on H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0i</sub>-mode quasi-regular waveguide, but requires approximately twice smaller induction of the magnetostatic field in the area of interaction.

articleTitle: Distribution of currents at diffraction on metal dielectric structures in a waveguide
abstract: Results of a numeral calculation of superficial currents are brought in conducting films at diffraction of the electromagnetic fields on metal dielectric structures in a waveguide.

articleTitle: Radiation protective action of low-intensity extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation
abstract: It was shown for the first time that the exposure of mouse blood leukocytes to low-intensity modulated extremely high-frequency electromagnetic radiation (EHF EMR) with effective parameters (carrier frequency of 42.2 GHz, intensity of 0.1 mW/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, exposure duration for 20 min, modulation frequency of 1 Hz) before and after the treatment with X-rays in a dose of 5 Gy caused pronounced radiation protective effect which is manifested as a decrease in DNA damage. It is supposed that the mechanisms of the radiation protective effect are connected with an induction of adaptive response by reactive oxygen species.

articleTitle: Wave bunches multiple reflections and interference in kaleidoscopic structures
abstract: Variants of multiple reflections and interference schemes of both traveling and surface waves in kaleidoscopic structures are considered. Methods of their practical usage were discussed as well.

articleTitle: Permutation application in telecommunication systems
abstract: The article concerns the use of permutations as the error-correcting code. Assessment of structural redundancy of permutations is made. Based on the analysis of errors occurring in the process of the permutations transfer, the rate of detected errors in the code on permutations is studied.

articleTitle: GaN quasimonolithic two-stage power amplifier with 8–18 GHz frequency band
abstract: This paper presents the results of development of experimental samples of GaN quasi-monolithic IC (QMIC) two-stage power amplifier with the output power up to 1.5 W and the gain 12-16 dB in 8-18 GHz frequency band.

articleTitle: Parasitic current channel suppression and output power increasing in pHEMT's
abstract: The first result of power pHEMT's with the optimized quantum well and additional potential barrier development have been submitted. High power transistor with gate length about (0.4…0.5) μm and 0.8 mm width demonstrates specific output power higher than 1.4 W/mm, associated gain higher than 8 dB and efficiency about 50% at 10 GHz.

articleTitle: Functional coatings with shape memory effect for telecommunication devices
abstract: This paper presents the results of studying the properties of a new class of nanostructured coatings obtained by the implantation with nitrogen ions in TiNi with a shape memory effect (SME). A comprehensive study of the mechanical and tribological properties showed a improvement in physical and mechanical properties of the material: superelasticity, microhardness, resistance to wear. The possibility of EPF successful application in various branches of engineering.

articleTitle: Influence of the thickness of nanosized silicon nitride films on a stoichiometric composition
abstract: The experimental study of silicon nitride films obtained by magnetron sputtering of crystalline silicon in a mixture of argon and nitrogen is demonstrated. The changes of the intrinsic properties of protective and insulating SiN<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> structures with thicknesses of 40-200 nm depending on the underlying surface and of the working thickness were shown.

articleTitle: Optimization of parameters of modem radio-relay communication line
abstract: The paper describes the principle of optimizing parameters of a modem on the basis of experimentally measured impulse response of the trace.

articleTitle: Diagram of formation and delivery of multiplexes to digital transmitters
abstract: The scheme of formation and delivery of multiplex to digital transmitters for DVB-T2 network is presented.

articleTitle: Application of autogenerator method for measuring of the air refraction coefficient in a stream
abstract: The radiorefractometer on the basis of an open resonator in the feed-back circuit of a transistor amplifier of 8mm wave range is offered. The air under test is pumped through the pipe set in a resonator. The index of refraction of the air is calculated using the value of generation frequency.

articleTitle: Intellectual probabilistic simulation of the reliability of quadrupole systems
abstract: An approach to the study of the reliability of complex quadrupole systems based on the use of intellectual simulation is offered, taking into account the mutual influence of components in the system.

articleTitle: The Russian-Ukrainian VLBI Network on the basis of "Quasar-Kvo" radio telescopes and RT-22 "Simeiz"
abstract: In order to develop new research in radio astronomy and astrophysics, geodynamics using the method of radio interferometry with very long baselines based on RT-22 of Science Research Institute "Crimean Astrophysical Observatory" and radio astronomy observatories of "Quasar-KVO" network of Institute of Applied Astronomy, a new research tool - the Russian-Ukrainian VLBI Network, is created. With VLBI network "Quasar-Simeiz" the researches in cm- and mm-wavelengths are started, and the first scientific results are obtained.

articleTitle: 15 MW, 40%, 30 GHz, 0.5 μs gyroklystron
abstract: The IAP team has been working on creation of the pulsed gyroklystron operated in the millimeter wavelength range for several recent years. Unlike its predecessors working at symmetrical TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">01</sub> and TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">02</sub> modes, the klystron works at a sequence of high-order TE52 - TE<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">53</sub> modes [1]. This allows raising the output power significantly by increasing the transverse cross section of the interaction space, while preventing the system from self-excitation and microwave breakdowns, as well as simplifying the system, which forms a helical electron beam with the required intensity and low spread of electrons over transverse velocities and a high pitch factor.

articleTitle: The study of chaotic dynamics of electron beam in the traveling-wave tube collector
abstract: The numerical study of the dynamics of the electron beam in the traveling-wave tube (TWT) collector has been made.

articleTitle: Investigation of carbon nanostructures under stationary quasi-equilibrium condensation
abstract: In this work we considered the evolution of structural and morphological characteristics of carbon condensates during their growing within the accumulative plasma-condensate system, which allows carrying out the technological process near the point of thermodynamic equilibrium. The condensates have been studied with TEM and SEM.

articleTitle: Influence of electron beam misalignment on characteristics of gyrotrons
abstract: A number of reasons such as technological errors in the process of gyrotron's manufacture or inaccurate alignment of the magnetic field of the solenoid may lead to the formation of the misalignment. It means that we face a situation when the axis of the leading centers of the electron beam orbits do not coincide with the axis of the resonator. The effect that arises in this situation involves a violation of axial symmetry of the cavity-beam. With increasing of output frequency of the device this problem becomes more acute and almost inevitable.

articleTitle: Using of microwave radiation for noninvasive diagnostics
abstract: It is shown that millimeter-wave electromagnetic radiation can be used for developing noninvasive diagnostics techniques.

articleTitle: Investigation of frequency dependents of Contactless Control Microstrip Line on Semiconductor Substrate
abstract: In this paper we give the structures of Contact-less Control Microstrip Line on Semiconductor Substrate (CCMLSS). Parameters and characteristics of CCMLSS have changes under the influence of potential applied to a special control plate. This plate is located above the CCMLSS and has some potential relative to the line common ground. There are equivalent circuits of CCMLSS and results of numerical simulation of Amplitude-Frequency Characteristics (AFC) and Phase-Frequency Characteristics (PFC) for zero and maximum control potential. AFC is ratio transmission power modulus (RTPM) and PFC is phase of ratio transmission power (RTPP) of CCMLSS.

articleTitle: Pulse wave registration method by the instrumentality of microstrip resonators
abstract: A new method for detecting a pulse wave with an electromagnetic sensor is developed. The method of calculating the dielectric constant of biological objects on the basis of experimental data on the resonant frequency of the microstrip resonator is shown. The time dependence of the amplitude of the reflected wave microstrip resonator which is caused by blood filling of vessels is obtained experimentally.

articleTitle: Selection of an optimal algorithm for correction of parameters for multiparameter adaptive information tranfer system
abstract: A device and an algorithm constructed for functioning the multiparameter adaptive information transfer are developed. This system provides for efficient, error-correcting transmission of data on the criteria for maximizing the transmission rate, minimizing the number of bit errors during the reception.
